VAs_W3nacU2YKzbYuUaURg.description: Wether it's gonna be a standup fight or just another bughunt, this ship series, designed by AgentBunni, is up for the task.
VAs_W3nacU2YKzbYuUaURg.name: Agent B1
VAs_W3nacU2YKzbYuUaURg.specialDescription: The Agent B1 can deploy and place sneaky bombs on enemies. Shoot to deploy and shoot a second time to detonate.
VAs_W3nacU2YKzbYuUaURg.upgradeDescription: Technichans were able to factoy install a faster engine and power core on the B1.

alfVOmk4jUmkabgc2q_-Sw.description: This vessel is one of a kind. It has a very special graphene hud that enables the pilot to trigger short periods of cloaking. Also, when not cloaked, the design is top notch.
alfVOmk4jUmkabgc2q_-Sw.name: Assassin-T29
alfVOmk4jUmkabgc2q_-Sw.specialDescription: Equipped with a ship specific cloaking device that is not possible copy to other ships.
alfVOmk4jUmkabgc2q_-Sw.upgradeDescription: The ship is delivered with a super charged engine.

H1XyZ2LoLUKkzwAA4ivQnQ.description: Standard space explorer. Durable and sturdy.
H1XyZ2LoLUKkzwAA4ivQnQ.name: Astro Falcon

Cjph5JLVY0O_9xtDhoLMbA.description: The Aurora ship is an identitcal copy of the Supporter V1 class on the inside. But since it was made in an isolated hangar in space the hull looks a bit different.
Cjph5JLVY0O_9xtDhoLMbA.name: Aurora V2
Cjph5JLVY0O_9xtDhoLMbA.specialDescription: Is equipped with a boomerang weapon and a light speed boost.
Cjph5JLVY0O_9xtDhoLMbA.upgradeDescription: A nicely upgraded engine together with a robust hull makes it a reliable spacecraft.

keqvQhU2h0SMlynePKTR_Q.description: Created by a mad man and is used by the nezerians to fight Aureus.
keqvQhU2h0SMlynePKTR_Q.name: Bionic Daemon
keqvQhU2h0SMlynePKTR_Q.specialDescription: Corrosive teeth delivers a fatal and immediate dose of corrosive poison on impact.
keqvQhU2h0SMlynePKTR_Q.upgradeDescription: Doesn't have any pre-installations, it's delivered with basic augmentations.

z1X7x6F6E0iSVVf_U5iu5Q.name: Bionic Larva
z1X7x6F6E0iSVVf_U5iu5Q.specialDescription: Immensely powerful 360 lightning! Can NOT be replicated in the pirate bay.

Lzpw8_QrGkq7gbQZxq1c7g.description: The latest creation of a mad man is a large flying machine with a deadly bite.
Lzpw8_QrGkq7gbQZxq1c7g.name: Bionic Queen
Lzpw8_QrGkq7gbQZxq1c7g.specialDescription: The jaws deals heavy damage to anyone who gets caught between them. Can NOT be replicated in the pirate bay.
Lzpw8_QrGkq7gbQZxq1c7g.upgradeDescription: It's a flying insect, what more do I need to tell you...

QMisF58IfU-4pN8B8p3idg.description: Noxium is the most toxic substance in the known universe. This ship have a core of Noxium contained in a extremely powerful magnetic field. The weapons are based on releasing a tiny fraction of the core upon firing.
QMisF58IfU-4pN8B8p3idg.name: C8 Noxium
QMisF58IfU-4pN8B8p3idg.specialDescription: The core is exposed on death resulting in heavy damage on nearby ships.
QMisF58IfU-4pN8B8p3idg.upgradeDescription: The ship comes with the strong armour needed to contain it's highly dangerous core of Noxium.

XMZGEeLn4EO4bAqD6LY6bw.description: After creating the the B1 series Agent Bunni disappeared to the outer rim. According to rumors he is the designer of Chrono, but nobody really knows.
XMZGEeLn4EO4bAqD6LY6bw.name: Chrono
XMZGEeLn4EO4bAqD6LY6bw.specialDescription: The Chrono Laser deals very high damage in a line infront of the ship.
XMZGEeLn4EO4bAqD6LY6bw.upgradeDescription: Chrono is well equipped and has a powerfull power source.

MjFWoGWfv0C42KsfbvgUYQ.description: If you have an "I brake for nobody" attitude, this baby is for you.
MjFWoGWfv0C42KsfbvgUYQ.name: Collector

bg8rdztQTkGh5AtW2xbFHQ.description: Its really creamy. And very puffy.
bg8rdztQTkGh5AtW2xbFHQ.name: Creampuff

qR4l2lErdUugZRSToo10fw.description: This ship was constructed on the planet Crynos as a sea probe by the infamous Nightrage. However, Crynos crystal technologies have immense powers and the ship has been transformed into a lethal but very fragile weapon. All other technologies from Crynos have been lost.
qR4l2lErdUugZRSToo10fw.name: Crystal
qR4l2lErdUugZRSToo10fw.specialDescription: Prismatic crystal hails that carries an immense omni energy causing severe damage.
qR4l2lErdUugZRSToo10fw.upgradeDescription: Incredible power and a fairly upgraded engine.

twg3qNyXyke2nA6-13d9tg.description: The DMAT-90 is a fast and furious ship that is very popular among renegades in Zergilin.
twg3qNyXyke2nA6-13d9tg.name: DMAT-90
twg3qNyXyke2nA6-13d9tg.specialDescription: Gatling Laser is one of few mid range energy weapons weapons with short reload time.
twg3qNyXyke2nA6-13d9tg.upgradeDescription: Comes with decent armor and base equipment.

K7JVdmT-I0qxhe2VKWsUgA.description: Not much is known about the Eagle Eye series. Manufatured on the planet Valen in a well guarded area, only accessible to the ship designers which also build every part by hand.
K7JVdmT-I0qxhe2VKWsUgA.name: Eagle Eye
K7JVdmT-I0qxhe2VKWsUgA.specialDescription: The Eagle Eye is equipped with the "Eagle Needle" which shoots bursts of homing needle projectiles. The needles have an advanced "Shield Steel" technology installed which can magnetically transfer the targets shield energy to your shields.
K7JVdmT-I0qxhe2VKWsUgA.upgradeDescription: The Eagle eye is equipped with a supercharged engine straight from factory.

fkiaE6cc7EGY4Rzdu-78Pg.description: The Eldorado SE-24 is the latest in Luxury space travel, no expenses spared. The hull of the ship is entirely made out of 24k gold. Unfortunately, gold is not a very useful structural material. So, extremely advanced technology had to be developed to compensate for the ship's structural weakness and immense mass.
fkiaE6cc7EGY4Rzdu-78Pg.name: Eldorado SE-24
fkiaE6cc7EGY4Rzdu-78Pg.specialDescription: The ship comes with a system launching guided solid gold missiles, which attempts to ram its targets. It also come with a Flak Cannon for dealing with close range targets.
fkiaE6cc7EGY4Rzdu-78Pg.upgradeDescription: The ship comes with fully upgraded shield, armor, power system, engine, and teleport device for the owners conveniences.

cxL32k_l1E2wgnnhJ8RhMQ.description: The Explorer 062 has a modified power core that reroutes 80% of the weapon system power to the engines. This results in a significant speed boost and makes the ship ideal for long distance travels.
cxL32k_l1E2wgnnhJ8RhMQ.name: Explorer 062
cxL32k_l1E2wgnnhJ8RhMQ.specialDescription: The Explorer 062 has a standard Energy Nova installed on delivery.

bMlvTi7PW06mp0kP-LFoug.description: This ship has seen the end of times and the destruction of the universe.
bMlvTi7PW06mp0kP-LFoug.name: Golden Heart
bMlvTi7PW06mp0kP-LFoug.specialDescription: Golden torpedos. This rare weapon is not seen often anymore. Hard to master able to cause massive damage.
bMlvTi7PW06mp0kP-LFoug.upgradeDescription: The gold plating is mostly for the  looks, but underneath is a rock solid hull, a boosted engine+ extra shield and power core.

mEmwT5wK1U-T9KL1Cwlkvw.description: Another one of Xhargregs weird creations.
mEmwT5wK1U-T9KL1Cwlkvw.name: Hellbat
mEmwT5wK1U-T9KL1Cwlkvw.specialDescription: If you enjoy lighting your enemies on fire, the Hellbat is definitely the ship for you.
mEmwT5wK1U-T9KL1Cwlkvw.upgradeDescription: It comes with natural tough armor.

7w762dHumkSyDgNKrGMjzg.name: Horror Pumpkin
7w762dHumkSyDgNKrGMjzg.upgradeDescription: It comes with Pumpkin Armor, Pumpkin Shields, Pumpin Batteries and Pumpkin Thrusters... to fulfill all your pumpkin needs...

lQLbLoLreE6Mu9m10puBRQ.description: A powerful ship based on replicated stolen Aureus technology. A lot of effort went into the creation of this ship.
lQLbLoLreE6Mu9m10puBRQ.name: Judicator Prototype
lQLbLoLreE6Mu9m10puBRQ.specialDescription: The Judicator comes with three special weapons.
lQLbLoLreE6Mu9m10puBRQ.upgradeDescription: The Judicator is delivered with highly effective shields.

G8w1B5UeNUir6Wj7ohpriw.description: This military edition served as a heavy fighter in the Stingray nebula wars against the Nezerians. Its massive armor is very difficult to penetrate.
G8w1B5UeNUir6Wj7ohpriw.name: Juggernaut
G8w1B5UeNUir6Wj7ohpriw.specialDescription: The military juggernaut is specialized in high velocity and rapid fire impact weapons.
G8w1B5UeNUir6Wj7ohpriw.upgradeDescription: The Juggernaut is always delivered with extra plating.

CLVKoihg1EyY_jK5D8mWWA.description: This rare retro explorer has been a collection item for many space pioneers and is regarded as a must have for any decent collector. The ship was only produces during a limited period.
CLVKoihg1EyY_jK5D8mWWA.name: Jupiter
CLVKoihg1EyY_jK5D8mWWA.specialDescription: Comes with a standard Energy Nova.
CLVKoihg1EyY_jK5D8mWWA.upgradeDescription: Comes with small engine enhancements and a standard armor.

xxGYahwdREakkrJusV0zHA.description: The medic ship is a true hero in space with its area of effect healing capabilities. The Medic C2 has served faithfully in the Nezerian Wars.
xxGYahwdREakkrJusV0zHA.name: Medic C2
xxGYahwdREakkrJusV0zHA.specialDescription: Repair-Nanobot spray is a unique weapon with area of effect healing capabilities.
xxGYahwdREakkrJusV0zHA.upgradeDescription: Has a special setup with small amplifiers but high-velocity repeaters.

kBGo5xJkZUivH1h4MCxIkA.description: An easy to use and sturdy ship with many good qualitiess. The ship was inspired by an old Agent design but was transformed by a mad scientist in Neurona.
kBGo5xJkZUivH1h4MCxIkA.name: Neutron X
kBGo5xJkZUivH1h4MCxIkA.specialDescription: A 360 degree particle gun that fires accelerated neutrons.
kBGo5xJkZUivH1h4MCxIkA.upgradeDescription: Is delivered with a good engine and a basic shield and armor.

L_ATA6ePFkaSe3pShVMTeQ.description: A discarded prototype for the Nexar Blade class ship, discovered at a conquered Nexar Hanger. The ship has been heavily modified to allow for a humanoid crew.
L_ATA6ePFkaSe3pShVMTeQ.name: Nexar Blade
L_ATA6ePFkaSe3pShVMTeQ.specialDescription: The Nexar Blade is a robust in-fighter. It comes with an extremely deadly Kinetic Phase Blade, excellent armor, and highly optimized systems. However, the design didn’t leave much space for power generators resulting in very poor power regeneration.The weapon CAN NOT be copied to other ships.
L_ATA6ePFkaSe3pShVMTeQ.upgradeDescription: The Nexar Blade comes with upgraded armor and shields.

CqzP6sv5E0u_cpufgboXWw.description: A prototype for the Nexar Fighter class ship, discovered at a conquered Nexar Hanger. The ship has been heavily modified to allow for a humanoid crew.
CqzP6sv5E0u_cpufgboXWw.name: Nexar Fighter
CqzP6sv5E0u_cpufgboXWw.specialDescription: The Nexar Fighter is an excellent all around ship. Designed to be able to fill multiple roles in the Nexar fleet. It comes with a powerful Nexar Blaster.
CqzP6sv5E0u_cpufgboXWw.upgradeDescription: The ship comes with improved armor, engines, power systems and shields.

SlYgUghEoUG1fq56de0bjw.description: A pristine prototype for the Nexar Shadow class ship, discovered at a conquered Nexar Hanger. The ship has been heavily modified to allow for a humanoid crew.
SlYgUghEoUG1fq56de0bjw.name: Nexar Shadow
SlYgUghEoUG1fq56de0bjw.specialDescription: The Nexar Shadow class ship is designed to deal extreme amounts of burst damage, Sacrificing power regen for a larger power pool.  It's ideal for assassination missions.The weapons CAN NOT be copied to other ships.
SlYgUghEoUG1fq56de0bjw.upgradeDescription: The ship comes with an advanced fully upgraded power system as well as high performance engines.

6WJ85gHyC0KgmJcSSZXfCA.description: A pristine prototype for the Nexar Vindicator class ship, discovered at a conquered Nexar Hanger. The ship has been heavily modified to allow for a humanoid crew, resulting in reduced speed.
6WJ85gHyC0KgmJcSSZXfCA.name: Nexar Vindicator
6WJ85gHyC0KgmJcSSZXfCA.specialDescription: The Nexar Vindicator class ship is designed to excel at close to medium range combat. The ship comes with a special teleport device with a variable target range, depending on how long time the devices is charged before use. The weapons CAN NOT be copied to other ships.
6WJ85gHyC0KgmJcSSZXfCA.upgradeDescription: The ship comes with an advanced fully upgraded armor as well as above average shields .

h-bb0FxBBUmvqAV2j0ZXug.description: A strange ship of a mysterious origin. It’s still somehow able to maneuver despite the lack of any visible engines. Theories has it that the central orb is involved…
h-bb0FxBBUmvqAV2j0ZXug.name: Orbiter
h-bb0FxBBUmvqAV2j0ZXug.specialDescription: The Orbiter comes with a set of devestating lighting based weapons.
h-bb0FxBBUmvqAV2j0ZXug.upgradeDescription: It comes with a premanifactued complex power system.

rjv4nT7lsUOMj9eXuThPhw.description: The pirate series is a set of standard sturdy quality ships that gives that extra piratish look.
rjv4nT7lsUOMj9eXuThPhw.name: P1 Patrol

di3rSghfGUSVNYX8HFHcvA.description: A modified version of the P1 model, The modifications includes a new signal system, making sure nobody misses your presence.
di3rSghfGUSVNYX8HFHcvA.name: P1 Pirate
di3rSghfGUSVNYX8HFHcvA.specialDescription: The P1 Pirate is equipped with the missile launcher from start.
di3rSghfGUSVNYX8HFHcvA.upgradeDescription: The engine is souped up (using stolen equipment) on the P1 Pirate.

tx2VGh3l-U2Krrb4jmasjw.description: Wow, can you handle the attitude this ship breathes?
tx2VGh3l-U2Krrb4jmasjw.name: Pixi

_QQ1_tOoNkmAKVo2b8tYuA.description: For the true law protectors. This ship will not go unnoticed. Pirates beware!
_QQ1_tOoNkmAKVo2b8tYuA.name: Police Pursuit P1
_QQ1_tOoNkmAKVo2b8tYuA.specialDescription: A lightning gun is factory equipped on the Pursuit P1.
_QQ1_tOoNkmAKVo2b8tYuA.upgradeDescription: To get extra proctection from enemies  high impact weapons, this law enforcement vessel is equipped with an extra charged shield.

YwqkRwJHAkehvPeRacsSTQ.description: The first ever replica of an Aureus vessel. It was built from salvaged parts and re-painted with AF colors.
YwqkRwJHAkehvPeRacsSTQ.name: Portal
YwqkRwJHAkehvPeRacsSTQ.upgradeDescription: Includes a teleportation device and a standard issue blaster.

Bm4TmiT-DEmHH0niIcDVrw.description: Designed by well known and respected captain NightRage, this ship is surely ready for battle.
Bm4TmiT-DEmHH0niIcDVrw.name: Prophecy
Bm4TmiT-DEmHH0niIcDVrw.specialDescription: Hell Fire is a long range burn weapon with rapid fire. If you want to set something on fire from a safe distance this weapon is your choice.
Bm4TmiT-DEmHH0niIcDVrw.upgradeDescription: The preinstalled dual engine gives an extra boost straight from factory. Health, armor and shield is also factory improved.

89AAB785-2B70-8553-DC67-AB41780A5B96.description: Rapture is a fighter style ship with high speed and energy weapons for penetrating Nezerian defenses.
89AAB785-2B70-8553-DC67-AB41780A5B96.name: Rapture
89AAB785-2B70-8553-DC67-AB41780A5B96.specialDescription: The Plasma Trap, Electroctue and Twin Phaser will make short work of any enemy lacking resistance.
89AAB785-2B70-8553-DC67-AB41780A5B96.upgradeDescription: The ship has a decent engine pre-installed to ease kiting of the mindless bugs.

bXUzVqF2P024i7_EadA2Ug.description: The Antor Federation managed to copy the Aureus projection technology and this is the first prototype with photonic technology.
bXUzVqF2P024i7_EadA2Ug.name: Retro
bXUzVqF2P024i7_EadA2Ug.specialDescription: The photonic blaster is a high-velocity projector that fires photonic particles.
bXUzVqF2P024i7_EadA2Ug.upgradeDescription: Is equipped with a photonic shield but doesn't have a hull.

26D6095B-CAE9-0836-C135-EE930F7F23D1.description: Ho Ho Ho! Merry Christmas! Ho Ho Ho!
26D6095B-CAE9-0836-C135-EE930F7F23D1.name: Rocket Sled
26D6095B-CAE9-0836-C135-EE930F7F23D1.upgradeDescription: At least it got excellent engines!

vL4prvOTS0OtlIEEv5psvw.description: Ever wanted to sail the space currents? Then this ride is made for you.
vL4prvOTS0OtlIEEv5psvw.name: Sail Fish
vL4prvOTS0OtlIEEv5psvw.specialDescription: The Piraya shoots homing fishlings that deals area damage on impact.
vL4prvOTS0OtlIEEv5psvw.upgradeDescription: The Sail Fish sports a fiskjet™ engine and boosted scale.

QJTrP7Mqdk2x6kv1taVBmQ.description: Design that ages back to the 1970s combined with state of the art technology enhances the owner with an impression that lasts. Also, believe it of not, this ship can be maneuvered standing up.
QJTrP7Mqdk2x6kv1taVBmQ.name: Scartrow
QJTrP7Mqdk2x6kv1taVBmQ.specialDescription: The Astro Lance is a super heavy impact damage weapon that boomerangs back to the owner. Used properly, this weapon is lethal.
QJTrP7Mqdk2x6kv1taVBmQ.upgradeDescription: Scartrow comes with an engine with a  turbocharged Strontium afterburner + a extra durable hull.

LWluPiIoTUq6t2CH6ijSLg.description: Argus Hemel was obsessed by death so he created this shrine as a tribute to his only god.
LWluPiIoTUq6t2CH6ijSLg.name: Skeletor
LWluPiIoTUq6t2CH6ijSLg.specialDescription: The Skeletor Lightning deals a tingeling "that was not so bad" impact damage. But, the real deal is the debuff dot damage that drains the targets life the seconds after impact.
LWluPiIoTUq6t2CH6ijSLg.upgradeDescription: The toxic waste boosted engine gives an extra punch + a hardened hull.

8MF0AISMwUiETtnF1GJO6g.description: This ship was constructed by the only inhabitant of the frozen wastelands of Ronduria. The man and myth (and bastard) Jon Snowball designed this awesome ship and eqipped it with an effective weapon - the Snow Cannon.
8MF0AISMwUiETtnF1GJO6g.name: Snowformer
8MF0AISMwUiETtnF1GJO6g.specialDescription: The Snow Cannon is not only humiliates the enemy - it also delivers a pretty good punch.
8MF0AISMwUiETtnF1GJO6g.upgradeDescription: The snowformed is delivered with a super charged engine.

3rIgXUs-60-PZB3aUqI_Ug.description: Once upon a time there was a footballmanager who traveled into space and created a new ship prototype. A rumour says it was named by a legendary game that was played a thousand years ago.
3rIgXUs-60-PZB3aUqI_Ug.name: Spacetrick

Yi1b1RUsP0urj_pXl4LD2g.description: This ship was constructed and design to honor one of the greatest wiki contributor and space pioneer in the Antor system.
Yi1b1RUsP0urj_pXl4LD2g.name: Spy-1
Yi1b1RUsP0urj_pXl4LD2g.specialDescription: The Infested Missile reduces enemy resistance against kinetic damage.
Yi1b1RUsP0urj_pXl4LD2g.upgradeDescription: All abilities are accessible but with low upgrades.

RJMvDe02uk-711-HEgskZA.description: The Supporter ship class was made to fund the Astroflux project and its devote developers.
RJMvDe02uk-711-HEgskZA.name: Supporter V1
RJMvDe02uk-711-HEgskZA.specialDescription: Is equipped with a boomerang and has a slight speedboost.
RJMvDe02uk-711-HEgskZA.upgradeDescription: Comes with a fairly upgraded engine and basic set.

RrC8OlOp80KZthu_xpCxxg.description: A standard model for space explorers.
RrC8OlOp80KZthu_xpCxxg.name: T1 Winger

GOUN-DLB8k6x3dliHEX0XQ.description: This ship is really heavy and slow due to its enormous shield batteries and thick plating. If you need to escort someone and tank enemy fire, this is your choice.
GOUN-DLB8k6x3dliHEX0XQ.name: Tanker A1
GOUN-DLB8k6x3dliHEX0XQ.specialDescription: Concussion spheres lower the damage output of enemies and bounces between targets.
GOUN-DLB8k6x3dliHEX0XQ.upgradeDescription: To cope with deadly strangers this ship has an excellent defense matrix and high power batteries. The only downside is that it is a bit slow.

Ijt0GhS0hkS09bixHLNEYg.description: Assembled using old UHF antennas, it's a special ship with incredible shields.
Ijt0GhS0hkS09bixHLNEYg.name: Transmitter

nGQoNJZcy0iFFnEFLWdkVw.description: Want to ride in style? This ship make sure you don't pass by unnoticed.
nGQoNJZcy0iFFnEFLWdkVw.name: Traveller

1uFzXM6o2kWSX0LO8_KTMQ.description: All history of its makers have been lost in time, a relic of a golden age of an unknown civilisation. It holds immense power, but we do not have the capabilities nor the knowledge to fully unleash its real potential. It has an unknown house emblem on both wings.The Vanquisher is a difficult ship to use but with great potential for those which can master it.
1uFzXM6o2kWSX0LO8_KTMQ.name: Vanquisher
1uFzXM6o2kWSX0LO8_KTMQ.specialDescription: It comes with three weapons.- Gauss Cannon GAU-186- Cruise Missiles VX-23- Plasma Flares HG-168The weapons can not be copied.
1uFzXM6o2kWSX0LO8_KTMQ.upgradeDescription: Has an unknown material encasing all the hull, seemingly making it very sturdy. Its power core seems to be working autonomously.

wHuii5seLEO7hIxEhg5l2Q.description: In a secret collaboration by Doctor Drak and Professor Xhargreg, they developed this with magnificent toxic weaponry. This ship is sleek, fast, and perfect for anyone who wishes to strike fear into their foes.
wHuii5seLEO7hIxEhg5l2Q.name: Venom V-30
wHuii5seLEO7hIxEhg5l2Q.specialDescription: Venom V30 comes with Poison Arrow, a charge up long range weapon, and Viper Fangs, a medium range high damag busrt weapon.Viper Fangs CAN NOT be coppied.
wHuii5seLEO7hIxEhg5l2Q.upgradeDescription: Venom V30 comes prepackaged with a durable hull and shielding, to survive the onslught of its enemies.

C924DEA0-255F-8C4D-9E85-3C4EFDCF9DFC.description: A kinetic oriented assault machine with an agile shield defense grid. Famous for its spike strip weaponry and built in hydralic fusion booster.
C924DEA0-255F-8C4D-9E85-3C4EFDCF9DFC.name: Vulture
C924DEA0-255F-8C4D-9E85-3C4EFDCF9DFC.specialDescription: Kinetic damage and engine capacity is increased by the hydralic fusion booster.
C924DEA0-255F-8C4D-9E85-3C4EFDCF9DFC.upgradeDescription: The ship is delivered with both armor and engine upgrades.

-1FFDUg0CEmaCTjjI195Sg.description: The X-121 Carrier is a state of the art drone control ship. It can rapidly construct and launch several types of drones.
-1FFDUg0CEmaCTjjI195Sg.name: X-121 Carrier
-1FFDUg0CEmaCTjjI195Sg.specialDescription: The Advance X-121 comes with three types of drones and a target painter.
-1FFDUg0CEmaCTjjI195Sg.upgradeDescription: The X-121 carrier is heavily armoured, it comes with a fully upgraded armor tech.

07rY1lCHKEGfKZ7WnVV4fA.description: The X-34 Carrier was constructed to control the lesser regions of Antor system with its drone construction technology.
07rY1lCHKEGfKZ7WnVV4fA.name: X-34 Carrier
07rY1lCHKEGfKZ7WnVV4fA.specialDescription: Can construct a new X-32 fighter drone in just a few seconds.
07rY1lCHKEGfKZ7WnVV4fA.upgradeDescription: Produced with basic armor and engine.

cdpN-eB2DEykc3sOOClIHQ.description: Bwok bwok bwak bwok... BWAK!It's clearly a chicken... if you just ignore the bug legs...The great scientist Xhargreg have created a vastly improved chicken... just in time for easter! How could life get any better?
cdpN-eB2DEykc3sOOClIHQ.name: Xhargregs Mutated Chicken

C5weu3O-OUqW-W2zuKbKXQ.description: The Y2K V-16 was originally designed a a firework launch platform. However, the technology used was far too advanced for its purpose, it didn't take long until someone figured out the ship was suitable for launching fireworks at your friends and foes alike.
C5weu3O-OUqW-W2zuKbKXQ.name: Y2K V-16
C5weu3O-OUqW-W2zuKbKXQ.specialDescription: It comes with nuclear powered fireworks, which is clearly safe...
C5weu3O-OUqW-W2zuKbKXQ.upgradeDescription: The ship comes with standard armor, shields, engine, and power systems.

x-4pRRKTbECoLTNQ8phwsw.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 29 (0-0)
x-4pRRKTbECoLTNQ8phwsw.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 29
x-4pRRKTbECoLTNQ8phwsw.description: Search for Dr. Mira, she should be on a planet somewhere in Neurona.
x-4pRRKTbECoLTNQ8phwsw.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “What do you want? Can’t you tell I’m busy here? I’m trying to learn a moth-larva to speak our language!”Nezerian Scientist: “Harga nuur zharg kraka zherphek zhur.”Dr. Mira: “Fascinating!”Nezerian Scientist: “Hur gak?”Dr. Mira: “Ok… let’s go somewhere less hostile and talk. How about to the Anchorhead Cantina?”

yepufto0s0-59CwvAtulNg.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 40 (0-0)
yepufto0s0-59CwvAtulNg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 40
yepufto0s0-59CwvAtulNg.description: Bring the resources to the AF Recycle Station in Fulzar.
yepufto0s0-59CwvAtulNg.completeDescription: Lieutenant Nguyen: “That should be enough to finish our new Battleship class vessels. It’s time to strike the Aureus and take down their major force in the area; the Executor. When you are ready go talk to Admiral Ymer.”

mChKNgc0c0CrIC9gvIh1Eg.label: (timed): Recycle [amount] (9-0)
mChKNgc0c0CrIC9gvIh1Eg.title: Recycle [amount]
mChKNgc0c0CrIC9gvIh1Eg.description: Recycle times! We need you to bring [amount] units of Hydrogen Spill to the recycle station, Captain.

FKZQszpQX0-vnZSypc6WFg.label: (timed): Larva Research (10-0)
FKZQszpQX0-vnZSypc6WFg.title: Larva Research
FKZQszpQX0-vnZSypc6WFg.description: The I8-7 research organisation have requested our aid to [h]land[/h] on [location1] and [location2]. When landed the ship will automatically do an analysis. Their research is unknown and potentially dangerous.

W9q67O80q0SOiPa7qJR-gw.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 14 (0-0)
W9q67O80q0SOiPa7qJR-gw.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 14
W9q67O80q0SOiPa7qJR-gw.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Odd… you’re alive? You haven’t mutated into some horrid abomination? Sigh… I guess you can’t have everything... I might have forgot to tell you about their mutagenic poison… Anyway return here with the Macrophage samples”
W9q67O80q0SOiPa7qJR-gw.description: Go to the secret Nezerian research facility at x: -318, y: 752 in Sarkinon, gather samples from 8 Experimental Macrophages. *hint: You need to figure out some way to deal with their insane healing abilities.

O0nluMgQm06rO06tdoTKbA.label: New Lifeform: Part 14 (0-0)
O0nluMgQm06rO06tdoTKbA.title: New Lifeform: Part 14
O0nluMgQm06rO06tdoTKbA.description: Bring the shocked and the somewhat dilerious Krux back to Fexucius in Sarkinon.
O0nluMgQm06rO06tdoTKbA.completeDescription: Krux: “Thank you for taking me home again, I remember everything now, but the sponge controlled every action I took. I think it had a very sofisticated mind, but it was very angry and it was hard to make sense of it all. But I’m glad you helped me get out of there in time, I wasn’t prepare to live the rest of my life as a sponge just yet.“

N-JSO0bx4EKgiOXF3BYdxA.label: Counter attack! - Part 24 (0-0)
N-JSO0bx4EKgiOXF3BYdxA.title: Counter attack! - Part 24
N-JSO0bx4EKgiOXF3BYdxA.description: Admiral McArthur: “I have received reports based on your scan data. Apparently the Nexar are unable to use sound for communication. Perhaps it’s time for a new attempt at negotiating. For this we will need the help of that madman Xhargreg… please try to convince him to help us. Find Xhargreg in Fulzar.”
N-JSO0bx4EKgiOXF3BYdxA.completeDescription: Xhargreg: “Greetings traveller! Have you found any ants yet?”*5 minutes later*Xhargreg: “Pff more questions about those bloody Nexar? Perhaps… for a bug leg… or even better 42 Bug Legs!”

W94VFib9Z0OsHW7jIsZeKw.label: Questions about that past: Part 12 (0-0)
W94VFib9Z0OsHW7jIsZeKw.title: Questions about that past: Part 12
W94VFib9Z0OsHW7jIsZeKw.description: Destroy the Dominator and quire it’s log files.
W94VFib9Z0OsHW7jIsZeKw.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “Looks like we got their log keeping… thingy, I’ll need to decrypt and translate them. I need a drink after all this action, so let’s head back to the Anchorhead Cantina.”

KDgdjexHZkCgww58LiwLUQ.label: (timed): Bug Smash (10-0)
KDgdjexHZkCgww58LiwLUQ.title: Bug Smash
KDgdjexHZkCgww58LiwLUQ.description: We have heard the Kritillian system is infested by insect-like creatures. We would like you to exterminate them.

peYYP6wl3keeALB4kKXY6g.label: The New Frontier: Part 5 (0-0)
peYYP6wl3keeALB4kKXY6g.title: The New Frontier: Part 5
peYYP6wl3keeALB4kKXY6g.description: Kill 5 Nezerian fighters in Fulzar to help Ace in their counter attacks.
peYYP6wl3keeALB4kKXY6g.completeDescription: Agent Ace: “It looks like the Nezerian Fighters caused you more trouble than expected. However, we don’t have time to babysit you. Try and collect 10 bionic implants, they can sometimes be salvaged from the remains of a bionic creature. We think they are key to find weaknesses in the bionic armor.

XBTLI9JQ_kuOaF43hZER7A.label: (timed): The Cleaning Lady! (82-0)
XBTLI9JQ_kuOaF43hZER7A.title: The Cleaning Lady!
XBTLI9JQ_kuOaF43hZER7A.description: "Oh yeah.. What every you do, don't mess with the cleaner lady."This was the last transmission we heard from a space pilot in Cynapsian three days ago. Please go there and destroy that abomination!

wlBfsbmmgkSrRkZh4lmW9w.label: The Cult: Part 4 (0-0)
wlBfsbmmgkSrRkZh4lmW9w.title: The Cult: Part 4
wlBfsbmmgkSrRkZh4lmW9w.description: Give the data chip to Kaalifax, an encryption expert. He should be working at the Recycle Station here in Durian.
wlBfsbmmgkSrRkZh4lmW9w.completeDescription: Kaalifax: “Ahh.. another problem to solve.. *squinting at the chip* ... I can see this is no ordinary data chip. How did you aquire it? But I guess that's not for me to ask.. However, I do require some kind of payment for this service. You see, I have a debt to pay to the mob, so I need you to recycle some stuff for me. If you do that I will help you.”

qITpecK-jkije3cjSjVCzg.label: (timed): Nezerian Ka-Boom! (38-0)
qITpecK-jkije3cjSjVCzg.title: Nezerian Ka-Boom!
qITpecK-jkije3cjSjVCzg.description: Kill [amount] Nezerian destroyers. They have been spotted in the elite zone in Sarkinon. They are most likely part of the invasion.

Hpi1_TVg1U2th9ClLayt5A.label: Bug Legs: Part 12 (0-0)
Hpi1_TVg1U2th9ClLayt5A.title: Bug Legs: Part 12
Hpi1_TVg1U2th9ClLayt5A.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”The Wasps have gather small pile of junk from their Nezerians victims… you can have it when if you return here… ”

Jusn_6tsJ0ShFNyJ4NK6gA.label: The Nezerian Threat (0-0)
Jusn_6tsJ0ShFNyJ4NK6gA.title: The Nezerian Threat
Jusn_6tsJ0ShFNyJ4NK6gA.description: AF Agent: “We’ve been observing these Nezerians for a while now and we’ve acquired data indicating an incoming assault within the next two hours. I’m afraid we got some bad news, among the reinforcements there is a new kind of ship, unlike anything we’ve ever seen before. We have no clue how to take them down… although almost certain death… perhaps you could assist us in trying to hold this sector once they arrive?
Jusn_6tsJ0ShFNyJ4NK6gA.completeDescription: AF Agent: “Incredible! We were sure this would have been the end of us all. The Antor Federation is forever indebted to you!”

6yqAzsIjq0W8ISMJyGRD-g.label: (timed): Renegade Scum! (75-0)
6yqAzsIjq0W8ISMJyGRD-g.title: Renegade Scum!
6yqAzsIjq0W8ISMJyGRD-g.description: There is a Renegade stronghold that we need to take out in the Durian sector. We need your assistance in destroying some of their ships. Please help us.

uGuyp_PiqkKcWBCPBCI6hg.label: Weapons Cartel: Part 3 (0-0)
uGuyp_PiqkKcWBCPBCI6hg.title: Weapons Cartel: Part 3
uGuyp_PiqkKcWBCPBCI6hg.description: AF Transmission: "Before we pursuit the cartel. Help the AF Hunters destroy and recapture the old junk yard from the Fanatics cult. It should be close to the elite zone in Kapello. Watch out for their piercing guns."
uGuyp_PiqkKcWBCPBCI6hg.completeDescription: AF Transmission: "They seem to be gone for now, but they will surely be back to create more trouble. However, we have found evidence they have aquired weapons from the cartel we discovered."

tYXtKnedD0GW84Numu0u9A.label: Bug Legs: Part 7 (0-0)
tYXtKnedD0GW84Numu0u9A.title: Bug Legs: Part 7
tYXtKnedD0GW84Numu0u9A.description: Xhargreg: ”It’s large.. yes… but not like a Moth Alpha or… those Bionic Queens… I need to study the Genetic Control Implants used on the Bionic Queens, about 8 of those should be enough, they might be useful in regulating their growth cycle… just think about the potentials here!” *Xhargregs mind floats off into his own little world… probably filled with even more gigantic wasps….*
tYXtKnedD0GW84Numu0u9A.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Great! One Implant is actually enough… but I like the number 8 more… anyway return here with the implants… I need to try them right away! Hahahahehahgrh… oh and I even have a reward for you!”

eyQqcmHMyU-vJzqjhc9zXg.label: Questions about that past: Part 3 (0-0)
eyQqcmHMyU-vJzqjhc9zXg.title: Questions about that past: Part 3
eyQqcmHMyU-vJzqjhc9zXg.description: Perhaps he would be more willing to talk if there’s any business to be gained. Gather at least 100 pieces of metal scraps, then return to Wrengher Jones recycle station and recycle it.

MgJB3MTTEE6KOxfrVX032w.title: Reach Level 2

6ijWEoLgVEWJ4fpigxsYCA.title: Eldorado: Part 5

There are pirates, slavers, cannibals, raiders and fanatics wreaking havoc everywhere. The key to survival is to keep your tech ahead of everyone elses, a very costly endeavour. zlb5ugHSZ0a82QN626LnVA.title: The Swarm: Part 1

peEGTifsAkyGlkmu9F-w5Q.description: Investigate the strength of the enemies in the area. Kill at least 75 enemies of various types.

WZfZzslEBkOYC9YXhjminw.description: Welcome to the Silver Wing Squadron! We've just finished developing a new weapon, the X27-S Smart Gun. ZLjFrNK7rUWNuYSAubiAwA.title: Questions about that past: Part 14
ZLjFrNK7rUWNuYSAubiAwA.description: Go to the Antor Federation Research Station in Hyperion and have them decrypt the logs from the Dominator.
ZLjFrNK7rUWNuYSAubiAwA.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “Finally, felt like it took forever… It seems like these files were partly damaged and only contains some limited information. The ship belonged to a species that refers to themselves as the Nezerians, hmmm… I’ve never heard that name before. Have you? The logs mentions receiving extreme damage during a battle in sector DRPZ-41292. Do you think this sector refers to Azuron? The Dominator must have been a remarkable ship given the amount of damage it received. I wonder what could’ve caused that amount of damage? A section of the log explains that the warp drive was destroyed during the battle, leaving the ship unable to swiftly return home. AMAZING! Think about it, a ship capable of warp jumping without the used of a warp gate, UNBELIEVABLE! We should inform Lieutenant Kreiger about our findings.”

Its cloaked and orbiting the black hole but we have identified the impulse signature, so you should be able to see it now."
Np6obY6mmkqdJGRC3TXQ3A.completeDescription: Renegade Scientist: "Are you mad!?! Worship the new gods and despair!"

EyYrrhkobkKMXkXhS-Lyfg.title: Recycle 50

Zo9LZFSpO06Yxr8M7yU1AQ.title: Fulzar Cruise!

YOLPIqBKT0Opwpsky8ZlIw.title: Reach Level 4

53cfhgvZ9U62C9s6dKCR3g.title: Spawner takedown

_VgjTzlAt0SUi_6AkNCdCw.title: Seeker and Destroy
_VgjTzlAt0SUi_6AkNCdCw.description: Innocent transport vessels has been shot down by patrolling Seekers. Help us take some of them down and receive a reward.

Pb2BrQMF-Uyr0PqDx9KV2w.title: Bounty Hunter Vorsran: Part 8

Pb2BrQMF-Uyr0PqDx9KV2w.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Outstanding captain! To be fair I never expected to see you again. You keep exceeding our wildest expectations! You have really earned the reward this time!”

UGpLSippE0qNQYQfcGRTbA.title: Stolen Technology: Part 2

UGpLSippE0qNQYQfcGRTbA.completeDescription: Pheww...Never thought we would suceed with that. However, it seems like the trail stops here. It's almost as if they vanished into thin air. Maybe we should land on the other planets as well to look for clues.

OV5YiBtmWUujEla9Lc_Q7A.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “Good to know there’s nothing to worry about. He barely managed to escape, he’s currently trying to get his ship repaired at Ronduria, head over there and find out what he knows.
OV5YiBtmWUujEla9Lc_Q7A.description: Check out the strength of the hostiles in the vicinity, takeout 6 nearby battle stations.

gaR8Ik_QIEGmbY6cUgPkpA.title: The Sacrifice: Part 1
gaR8Ik_QIEGmbY6cUgPkpA.description: The Helping Hand Foundation: “Examin the planet Amadun in Sarkinon and observe the neolitic tribe that has been discovered there. Be careful and don’t disturb their culture. Report back to us when you are ready.”

p3JV0ptCH0ujxMewBUq-wQ.title: The Sacrifice: Part 3

FXUjszIm7UOK2QCV7-ekBQ.title: Unknown Data: Part 3

FTnXLOVBJEOeutHvbkV1nw.label: A New Beginning: Part 11 (0-0)
FTnXLOVBJEOeutHvbkV1nw.title: A New Beginning: Part 11

The Antor Federation actually built most of the warp gates, although it was during the golden era, more than 500 years have past since then end of that age.”

eOqUW-fNK02r9ZRRn6wW_w.description: Greetings [player], I need you to get rid of [amount] locust. But I am not sure you will be able to finish it in time. Hurry!

pAHvc5k7l0-LsrUSv_QtYQ.label: (timed): Mandrom Terror (10-0)
pAHvc5k7l0-LsrUSv_QtYQ.title: Mandrom Terror
pAHvc5k7l0-LsrUSv_QtYQ.description: TERROR ALERT! The infamous Mandrom has been discovered in Arrenius. Bring all your friends and help us to destroy it before everything is lost.

dKap0SBQEEaR1j7Ap0FNIQ.label: Counter attack! - Part 20 (0-0)
dKap0SBQEEaR1j7Ap0FNIQ.title: Counter attack! - Part 20
dKap0SBQEEaR1j7Ap0FNIQ.description: Admiral McArthur: “I got another mission for you in the meantime while our scientists investigates the Nexar Ships we found at the hangar. There is a planet located here in the first circle, make you way there and scan the surface.”
dKap0SBQEEaR1j7Ap0FNIQ.completeDescription: Admiral McArthur: “Bring the data to the AF Research station located next to the Vorsran Warp Gate. While you were busy our scientist discovered a lot of useful information about Nexar Space Crafts, apparently they don’t have any life support systems. This means that the Nexar can survive at 3K and in the vacuum of space. Quite scary news… There are some good new as well, our engineers have figured out a way to add life support systems to Nexar Fighters. The downside is that the space consumed by the life support system weakens the vessels combat potential.

5Jro42pNO0ymr8YCVev0lw.label: Eldorado: Part 4 (0-0)
5Jro42pNO0ymr8YCVev0lw.title: Eldorado: Part 4
5Jro42pNO0ymr8YCVev0lw.description: Land on Vlardenon in Sarkinon and find the missing AF Agent that owes John a lot of money.
5Jro42pNO0ymr8YCVev0lw.completeDescription: John McClain: "There is one more client that owes me money, but he is a nasty renegade fraud that laughed at me when I asked him to return my investment. Please don't reason with him!"

2Fp37Cf_yEaLVP0EiveCdQ.label: Unknown Data: Part 6 (0-0)
2Fp37Cf_yEaLVP0EiveCdQ.title: Unknown Data: Part 6
2Fp37Cf_yEaLVP0EiveCdQ.description: Something happened to Jahaar While we were hunting the Stalkers. He is not linked to the net anymore. Rumors indicate that he was kidnapped by the Renegades and taken to Vetinari in the Venturi star system. We should investigate this...
2Fp37Cf_yEaLVP0EiveCdQ.completeDescription: We discovered an abandoned Renegade outpost and inside we found the corpse of Jahaar and a few remaining notes from his interrogators. He told them everything… including what was on our data chip. The note hinted of the existence of a hidden research facility somewhere in the Antor sector. The note ends with a personal comment: “I guess this had to be done… after all we are the renegades, we who have forsaken everything in our quest for vengeance… forsaken everything including our humanity… we must succeed at any cost”.Perhaps we can find someone who knows more at the Crossfire Cantina located in the Arrenius star system.

tD4dbD590Uic_BJT2WHZ8w.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 13 (0-0)
tD4dbD590Uic_BJT2WHZ8w.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 13
tD4dbD590Uic_BJT2WHZ8w.description: Find the hidden station and inquire about any suspicious individuals…
tD4dbD590Uic_BJT2WHZ8w.completeDescription: Black Market Merchant: “I might have seen someone like that, a little favour might refresh my memory. These bloody giant space moths keeps eating my supply vessels, most frustrating. Why would they even want to eat a metal ship? Take down a few and I will assist you in turn.”

qdkkl948jky4B475t8QFiA.label: (timed): Kill [amount] Bionic Plankton! (65-0)
qdkkl948jky4B475t8QFiA.title: Kill [amount] Bionic Plankton!
qdkkl948jky4B475t8QFiA.description: That is right, you shall kill bionic plankton for the sake of the federation. And for the research and scientific progress it will boost.

T31gYqR88EOXWhvGHYELrg.label: (PvP-6) Only the strongest (2-0)
T31gYqR88EOXWhvGHYELrg.title: (PvP-6) Only the strongest
T31gYqR88EOXWhvGHYELrg.description: Only the strongest will be allowed to join the ranks of the elite Blood-Claw faction within the guild. Considering your progress this far ... I think you could make it. If you succeed in this, brand new opportunities will be waiting for you. Some of the strongest fighters hang out in Mitrillion now, go there and dominate them. Show them who's the new boss. Get 25 kills in a row without getting destroyed even once.

E8I3ShBQ8kqDoso8cRzHjw.label: (timed): Regius Exterminatore! (80-0)
E8I3ShBQ8kqDoso8cRzHjw.title: Regius Exterminatore!
E8I3ShBQ8kqDoso8cRzHjw.description: The latest weapon in the Nezerian arsenal have appeared in Fulzar. It's a new kind of dreadnought that also works as a carrier, armed with nukes. Destroy it and Fulzar will be a lot safer.

m1B69BPI_EWXx-wPgB5Mbg.title: Dire Fest
m1B69BPI_EWXx-wPgB5Mbg.description: We want you to take down [amount] Dire Moths in the [h]Vibrilian System[/h]. Beware, they are usually not alone...

ZBLERKRdgkqUnVaZfrwdsQ.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 36
ZBLERKRdgkqUnVaZfrwdsQ.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Finally, we got one! Quick, let’s get out of here… before that giant ship comes after us.. head for the AFIS HQ in Arrenius.”
ZBLERKRdgkqUnVaZfrwdsQ.description: Destroy an Aureus Judicator and kidnap the pilot!

qLHMzHlU2UKBx5BSEV_0vA.label: (timed): The Nexar Elite (100-0)
qLHMzHlU2UKBx5BSEV_0vA.title: The Nexar Elite
qLHMzHlU2UKBx5BSEV_0vA.description: The Nexar Elite is made up by the best fighters in the Nexar Fleet. The Vindicator type is piloted by the elite among the elite. This is capable both at short and long range. It’s better to bring several allies along for this one.

TgNZKS8rHE6tqnsKvzlumg.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 38 (0-0)
TgNZKS8rHE6tqnsKvzlumg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 38
TgNZKS8rHE6tqnsKvzlumg.description: Operative Smith: “You survived??? That is at least some good news! It would have been a shame to lose such a useful tool. You better report everything to Admiral Cheng at the Warp Gate in Arrenius”
TgNZKS8rHE6tqnsKvzlumg.completeDescription: Admiral Cheng: “Good work, at least we know that negotiation with the Aureus is not an option. We should strike them now, they are clearly underestimating us. Maybe we can deal a decisive strike before they know what hit them... We need to prepare a massive strike force, this naturally requires a vast amount of resources and everyone will have to pitch in… collect 8000 pieces of large metal scraps and bring them to the AF Recycle Station in Fulzar.”

cMh4WTSQMEOBEzXbv6am-w.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 37 (0-0)
cMh4WTSQMEOBEzXbv6am-w.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 37
cMh4WTSQMEOBEzXbv6am-w.description: Return to the AFIS HQ in Arrenius.
cMh4WTSQMEOBEzXbv6am-w.completeDescription: AF Agent: “Let’s get on with this…”*The Aures Pilot has not made a single sound one the way here. It is wearing a full golden Body Armor.*Operative Smith: “Who are you? You better speak up… or I might have to get nasty” Dr. Mira: “Does it even know our language?”AF Agent: “You have one last chance… what do your people want with us?”Aures Pilot: “We Want You To Die.”Dr. Mira: “How can you know our language??”Aures Pilot: “The Languages Of Such Simple Life Forms Does Not Pose Much Of A Challenge.”AF Agent: “You better be careful scum… realise your situation!”Dr. Mira: “Why are you fighting everyone? If you are superior… shouldn’t you strive for galactic peace.”Aures Pilot: “You Are A Statistical Anomaly Which Must Be Corrected For. Your Only Useful Function Is Your Ability To Die.”Dr. Mira: “How rude...”Operative Smith: “I have had enough!”Aures Pilot: “My Brethren Have Arrived For Me.”*The Aures Pilot fades away leaving only a weak golden mirage in his place.*Operative Smith: “What a failure… hurry prepare for battle...”

RRB2DaAXPk-KGD9-nn2nTA.label: The Infestation: Part 1 (0-0)
RRB2DaAXPk-KGD9-nn2nTA.title: The Infestation: Part 1
RRB2DaAXPk-KGD9-nn2nTA.description: While doing some repairs on the ship we heard some local stories about the mechanical fortress close by. Recently the defenses around it has been increased and it now threatens this station. We should assist them in this fight.
RRB2DaAXPk-KGD9-nn2nTA.completeDescription: Captain! The lead engineer on the Upgrade Station wants to talk with us.

lVjIeg-DA0CAlruRG272jg.label: (timed): Nexar Sniper Duel (90-0)
lVjIeg-DA0CAlruRG272jg.title: Nexar Sniper Duel
lVjIeg-DA0CAlruRG272jg.description: We have discovered a new type of Nexar spacecraft with lethal sniping capabilities. It's called the Projector and it's common for pilots to be killed unaware of their presence. Find them and try to fight in close range as their reload is slow and turning radius is mediocre.

PiGvno4x7EWjEaPRHlUxmw.label: Counter attack! - Part 27 (0-0)
PiGvno4x7EWjEaPRHlUxmw.title: Counter attack! - Part 27
PiGvno4x7EWjEaPRHlUxmw.description: Land on Zhersis in Vorsran… and let Xhargreg attempt to negotiating with the Nexar… can this possibly end well?
PiGvno4x7EWjEaPRHlUxmw.completeDescription: Because of Xhargreg presence the Nexar didn’t open fire and you eventually managed to find a Nexar official of communicate with.*After a few minutes of Xhargreg and the Nexar standing in front of each other doing nothing… visible… the Nexar official suddenly turns very angry… and pulls a gun..*Xhargreg: “Now would be a good time to run! Hehehahahhehrhhg…”*You easily manage to escape the planet*Xhargreg: “Great news everyone! I successfully explained that AF intenteds to exterminate the Nexar as punishment for killing all those lovely bugs in Vorsran… Come see me once I have managed to set up a new research lab here in Vorsran… then we can continue with our plan!”Crew: “Oh no… this can’t be good”

PtCRSL7nMkOVOLZ0btQXGA.title: Counter attack! - Part 7
PtCRSL7nMkOVOLZ0btQXGA.completeDescription: Bring the Bug Legs to Xhargreg in Zergelin.

YE0WE3x7UUWfRxED0GdYBQ.title: Another Dimension: Part 5
YE0WE3x7UUWfRxED0GdYBQ.description: Lieutenant Reiland: "We have found evidence that Abraham fled to a fanatic shelter on a solitary asteroid in the Hyperion system: x = 1200, y = 750"
YE0WE3x7UUWfRxED0GdYBQ.completeDescription: Fanatic Abraham: "I rather die than being prosecuted by you maggots."Lieutenant Reiland: "Abraham is trying to escape with his Chrono ship, hurry up and take him down before he leaves the system!"

uwTjWPOcEkC63Gn3dcU5Nw.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 17 (0-0)
uwTjWPOcEkC63Gn3dcU5Nw.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 17

uwTjWPOcEkC63Gn3dcU5Nw.completeDescription: Renegade Defector: “Who are you? How did you even find me here? I’m actually very impressed…  I’m living in a small container in the middle of giant forest on a heavily defended alien planet in the middle of the insect infested Gellan sector… I thought people would take a hint that I maybe didn’t want to be found. So what do you want? You want information about the Nezerians? Sure… I’ll come with you, since you are going to have to find me a new hiding place, the Renegades don’t take very kindly to defectors.”

C-1vjA6cn0mlrunAOdYL2A.label: Counter attack! - Part 15 (0-0)
C-1vjA6cn0mlrunAOdYL2A.title: Counter attack! - Part 15

C-1vjA6cn0mlrunAOdYL2A.description: Engage in battle with 20 Nexar Skirmishers or Nexar Cluster Bombers.

2boNxu5uFki1VlR17sVSAA.title: Bug Legs: Part 16

2boNxu5uFki1VlR17sVSAA.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Excellent… this will allow me to create a whole new generation of wasps! I have prepared a truly unique reward for you this time…”Crew: “I don’t like this… a truly unique reward can’t possibly be anything good when it comes from this guy…”

N9BEHUzCnkuRg_Uo7X8AVA.label: Counter attack! - Part 10 (0-0)
N9BEHUzCnkuRg_Uo7X8AVA.title: Counter attack! - Part 10
N9BEHUzCnkuRg_Uo7X8AVA.description: Go to Xhargreg at the Abandoned Factory in Fulzar.
N9BEHUzCnkuRg_Uo7X8AVA.completeDescription: Giant Mutated Wasp: “Bzzzzz!”Xhargreg: “Bzzzzz! bzzz?”Giant Mutated Wasp: “Bzzzzz bzzz.”Crew: “What’s going on???”Xhargreg: “Great news everybody! All our wasp friends are safe!”*Two hours later*Xhargreg: “Oh, you want to know more about my species? Okok… they are called the Nexar… they live in Vorsran now… bla bla… they don’t like bugs… blabla.. they can travel through black holes… ***BORING!!!***Let’s change the subject to something a little more interesting… like ANTS!Hmmm.. got any advice on how to get ants?”

NdYdT1ziIkiuPAtvCvZi7w.label: (PvP-4) Demoralize the lawless (2-0)
NdYdT1ziIkiuPAtvCvZi7w.title: (PvP-4) Demoralize the lawless
NdYdT1ziIkiuPAtvCvZi7w.description: It's time to show them our strength, kill 8 hostile player in a row without dying.

GGY1YJiDI06p7HmzLOnL7w.label: Counter attack! - Part 26 (0-0)
GGY1YJiDI06p7HmzLOnL7w.title: Counter attack! - Part 26
GGY1YJiDI06p7HmzLOnL7w.description: Return to Xhargreg in Fulzar with the Bug Legs!
GGY1YJiDI06p7HmzLOnL7w.completeDescription: Xhargreg: “Great, just in time… I was afraid I wouldn’t have enough Bug Legs for my next experiment… the glorious 42 foot wasp! Hehehahahhrhhehhghhg… finally... that must be *it*...”*10 minutes later*Xhargreg: “Why are you still here? Oh? Fine… yes nexar doesn’t breather any gas… and we can easily survive in space… I had to make the fake voice box to speak with your weird species… nexar uses chemicals signals for communications… You want me to do what... harghegghhfghd… fine……… I’ll come with you to do this… negotiation... thing...”

48DwsQEPW0SugxGBk7QRpw.label: Questions about that past: Part 4 (0-0)
48DwsQEPW0SugxGBk7QRpw.title: Questions about that past: Part 4
48DwsQEPW0SugxGBk7QRpw.completeDescription: Wrengher Jones: “That’s a start at least. Thanks… I suppose. Very well? What do you want to know about Azuron? To be honest I don’t know very much, that battle was… just horrible, I used to be a Captain in the Azuron 3rd Fleet. I’m probably the only survivor from that unit. There was no warning, we had no clue where they came from, who they were or what they wanted. They opened fire before we even had time to try to open a communication channel. After a few seconds it was clear that we didn’t have a chance… we decided to abandon ship.. much good that did, they didn’t care about the intergalactic laws of war..  they used our escape pods... for target practise… I was to only one to survive. I don’t know if I could be called lucky… I drifted for over 2 years before I arrived in hyperion.”
48DwsQEPW0SugxGBk7QRpw.description: Take out 10 of the closest hostile battle stations and Wrengher Jones promised to tell you what he knows about Azuron.

KG4YJCr9tU6IH0rJRYo7HQ.label: A New Beginning: Part 2 (0-0)
KG4YJCr9tU6IH0rJRYo7HQ.title: A New Beginning: Part 2
KG4YJCr9tU6IH0rJRYo7HQ.completeDescription: Lieutenant Kreiger: “Good job there. Let me introduce myself. My name is Jacob Kreiger, I’m with the Antor Federation, I’m a Lieutenant in the 2nd division of the main fleet. We are trying to keep the order in this region, but we can’t do much good these days. I’m going to give you 200 steel, you can use this to acquire a weapon. I suggest that you head over to the Antor Federation Armory.
KG4YJCr9tU6IH0rJRYo7HQ.description: Lieutenant Kreiger promised to help us out if we can destroy 3 hostile space stations.

zd0ghwoXfEu30cR5XoD2qA.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 1 (0-0)
zd0ghwoXfEu30cR5XoD2qA.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 1
zd0ghwoXfEu30cR5XoD2qA.description: Operative Smith: “Ah there you are, we have been expecting your arrival to Arenius.... we have ‘obtained’ a copy of one report, which you ‘supposedly’ presented to a Lieutenant Kreiger… regarding the destruction of Azuron... yes… we are somewhat impressed with your fairly rapid progress… you could potentially be of some minor use to us.. if.. you are interested… that is… go to the AFIS HQ… it located southwest of the main system here in Arrenius...”
zd0ghwoXfEu30cR5XoD2qA.completeDescription: AF Agent: “So you have decided to join our organisation? Good… welcome to the AFIS. We could definitely use more ‘competent’ agents. We have obtained several points of intel indicating that this new alien race have a major base of operations somewhere in the Gellan system. Your first task is to head over to the Gellan system and contact operative Smith for further information, he’s at the Warp Gate in Kritillian.“

Y9AA-4mTJEa5PerYwpWcPQ.label: New Lifeform: Part 8 (0-0)
Y9AA-4mTJEa5PerYwpWcPQ.title: New Lifeform: Part 8
Y9AA-4mTJEa5PerYwpWcPQ.description: Land on Argenon in Cynapsian and kidnap a Nezerian soldier from an enemy fortress .
Y9AA-4mTJEa5PerYwpWcPQ.completeDescription: Krux: “You are bzzzt lucky today, we found one outside when he was doing a bzrtzz, gagged and ready to be eaten!”Crew: “This doesn’t seem right...”Krux: “Sponge is the main purpose in life.. I tell you..bzz”

visZ5zrLPE2isr_vv1WsLQ.title: The Swarm: Part 3
visZ5zrLPE2isr_vv1WsLQ.description: Lieutenant Keryn:  "Kill the swarm Queen during the next invasion. This will hopefully make the insects confused and maybe delay the next swarm."
visZ5zrLPE2isr_vv1WsLQ.completeDescription: Lieutenant Keryn: "The Queen died, but it made little difference except keeping the Arrenius system under control for another hour. However, we urge you to explore the Gellan sector to put an end to this."

2utfAcsl3Ua-IeMWzHLIFg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 27

2utfAcsl3Ua-IeMWzHLIFg.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Excellent… how ever there seems to be a bit of an issue here…”Nezerian Scientist: “GHAARK!! Herath kraka zherphek!”Operative Smith: “Oh do shut up! We need to find someone to help us translate their language… I leave this up to you...”

qDgXhMMZXUma7BljqEvl0w.label: We are under attack!: Part 1 (0-0)
qDgXhMMZXUma7BljqEvl0w.title: We are under attack!: Part 1
qDgXhMMZXUma7BljqEvl0w.description: Operative Smith: We are under attack! Last week ships from an unidentified race appeared just outside of here. At first they didn’t attack us. But unfortunately some overeager adventures attacked them… Now they are back… and in force this time… it seems like this new species have declared war on us. They have somehow opened up a black hole right next to our base and enemies are streaming into the system. Please help defend New Erath from the coming onslaught! Countless lives depend upon you!
qDgXhMMZXUma7BljqEvl0w.completeDescription: Operative Smith: Excellent work there! You’re getting quite proficient at this killing business... However, it doesn't seem to be enough to stop them. Their ranks are refilling too quickly. We have identified an enemy commander, whom we believe is in charge of the invading force. Take him out and maybe they will pull back...

uOnKRMU7WUWTkIh9JdwwuA.title: Kill the Macrophages!
uOnKRMU7WUWTkIh9JdwwuA.description: A new species has been sighted in Zergilin. To test the quality of our weapons we should try to kill [amount] of them.

rrohEFamlU2W48SWIUJ8pg.title: Suicide Mission
rrohEFamlU2W48SWIUJ8pg.description: There is a new suicide bug that has plauged the Mitrillion system. Investigate and kill [amount] of them.

pcwgmSHWjk6aW4XVtD8LVw.title: (PvP-5) A new hunting ground

eD7KAZd340uMwfZzA6D1MA.title: The Nexar Elite
eD7KAZd340uMwfZzA6D1MA.description: The Nexar Elite is made up by the best fighters in the Nexar Fleet. The Phaser type specializes at killing from a medium distance, its powerful Phaser Beam nullifing your energy resistances, avoid taking damages from any other sources while targeted by their Phasers.

m1gVvWQOGUmrFE6k4U9HOQ.title: The Warp Gate
m1gVvWQOGUmrFE6k4U9HOQ.description: Captain, it time you learn how to warp. You can get a warp pass to another system and fast travel at the Warp Gate. 828g86J150WQn3Q2Ntw7LQ.title: Reach Level 6
828g86J150WQn3Q2Ntw7LQ.description: We see some rare raw talent in you, Captain. But, can you harness your skills and use them in the correct way? We are not sure ... Prove it by reaching level 6, there is a nice reward containing [h]Hydrogen Crystals[/h] waiting for you!
