DRO7URAl1EmUDA3ELf66vg.title: Weapons Cartel: Part 2
DRO7URAl1EmUDA3ELf66vg.description: AF Transmission: "We have another fortified position in Kapello that we need to take care of. We need you to destroy 10 elite guardians. Beware of the turret Nova, it will destroy any missiles you fire at them."
DRO7URAl1EmUDA3ELf66vg.completeDescription: AF Transmission: "You have once again proven your skills as a captain. I think its time to move on and do us a real favour. We have located the weapon cartel and need you to take action."

2iM7Dkw01UKJdUIfMvHVMQ.label: Bug Legs: Part 21 (0-0)
2iM7Dkw01UKJdUIfMvHVMQ.title: Bug Legs: Part 21
2iM7Dkw01UKJdUIfMvHVMQ.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”I’m sure that I can reverse engineer how their teleport devices works from this… yes…”Crew: “Really?? That’s actually truly impressive.. for once..  “Xhargreg: ”The Wasps keeps bring back piles of those glowing things… please just take some of them… before I’m out of space for my highly important scientific research...“Crew: “More artifacts! I don’t know if this is even more impressive… Thanks?”Truly Gigantic Mutated Wasp: “Bzz! Thank! bzzz... You! Bzz..”Crew: “Errr… what’s happening here?”

Ov4M4wSf9EWlY8shNt6u3g.label: Bug Legs: Part 11 (0-0)
Ov4M4wSf9EWlY8shNt6u3g.title: Bug Legs: Part 11
Ov4M4wSf9EWlY8shNt6u3g.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Welcome back… I hope you were successful? Now… erhm… let’s use the Genetic Control Chip to modify the Wasps toxin to mimic the renegade one you collected..”*10 hours later*Even Larger Giant Mutated Wasp: “BzzZzzZzzzzZzz!!”*It looks happy…*Xhargreg: ”Success!!! Hahahahehahgrhegtrghh… You have been of great assistance to the wasps of this world! What more could you wish for in life???”Crew: “Perhaps… a reward?”Xhargreg: ”Next we have to deal with the Nezerians corrosive resistance… this is more tricky… the toxins of the Bionic Deamons could be useful… go gather some… or… a lot… like 8*8!”

QnonSMm0iEyKiNikOlyCvw.label: (timed): Kill the Triguns! (6-0)
QnonSMm0iEyKiNikOlyCvw.title: Kill the Triguns!
QnonSMm0iEyKiNikOlyCvw.description: [player], the Triguns around Ronduria in Durian keep shooting down our allies. Please take [amount] of them down.

swyE9Oqq4UyrW2Ry5XR3zg.label: (timed): Kill the Triads! (9-0)
swyE9Oqq4UyrW2Ry5XR3zg.title: Kill the Triads!
swyE9Oqq4UyrW2Ry5XR3zg.description: The Triads are a pain with their heavy plasma blast. They are killing our allies and we need you to take them down ASAP. Are you up for it?

5j9nrqBw3U2P24e_-mTAjA.label: The Twins: Part 1 (0-0)
5j9nrqBw3U2P24e_-mTAjA.title: The Twins: Part 1
5j9nrqBw3U2P24e_-mTAjA.description: Please help us, our twin ship was not able to drop out of warp and got lost in the outskirts of this solar system. We obtained these coordinates from there last distress call. It should be close to the Elite zone.Please open the map (M) and head to these coordinates:  x = -203, y = -414
5j9nrqBw3U2P24e_-mTAjA.completeDescription: The crew of the twin ship seems to gone. A few people on the station recall a vessel was salvaged just a few days ago. But they say there were no survivors. We should head back to Endarion and tell them the bad news.

jpOIkDCUg0WluxtbYqP8Ig.label: (timed): Kill the Zappers (6-0)
jpOIkDCUg0WluxtbYqP8Ig.title: Kill the Zappers
jpOIkDCUg0WluxtbYqP8Ig.description: [player], the Zappers around Kantalla in Durian keep shooting down innocent space travellers. Please take [amount] of them down.

eU-wF1D3Nk-hw82_yKkhyg.label: The Sacrifice: Part 2 (0-0)
eU-wF1D3Nk-hw82_yKkhyg.title: The Sacrifice: Part 2
eU-wF1D3Nk-hw82_yKkhyg.description: Kill [amount] Electro Blobs to impress the neolitic tribe on Amadun.
eU-wF1D3Nk-hw82_yKkhyg.completeDescription: Priest: “Hail the new god! A sign appeared on the sky again and an army of blobs were slayed. May he be worshipped in eternity and prepare the fiest of a thousand souls!”

_n_gIAAKAkS_kpg1FbcUTA.label: Stolen Technology: Part 1 (0-0)
_n_gIAAKAkS_kpg1FbcUTA.title: Stolen Technology: Part 1
_n_gIAAKAkS_kpg1FbcUTA.description: Captain, we just recieved information about a raid against the Fanatic stronghold on Arborea. We should investigate who is behind this attack. Maybe they can become our allies?
_n_gIAAKAkS_kpg1FbcUTA.completeDescription: We don't know who it was, but they seem to have stolen some sort of valuable technology from the Fanatics. And they left a warp trail leading to Hozar.

0FWaHFDI9UiRTEg4Y3lUBA.label: The Infestation: Part 7 (0-0)
0FWaHFDI9UiRTEg4Y3lUBA.title: The Infestation: Part 7
0FWaHFDI9UiRTEg4Y3lUBA.description: It looks like the insects have been assimilated by something and the bio energy readings seem to indicate that the source is located in Neurona. Head to the Upgrade Station in Neurona and find out what it is.
0FWaHFDI9UiRTEg4Y3lUBA.completeDescription: Finally, we are close enough to read out the bio energy signature. Ono calls it the Motherbrain and it seem to be partially biological and part Nezerian technology. This might be one of their sick experiments and maybe the cause of the chaos in the sector.

ss-4-C1lME-OpyffNG87vQ.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 15 (0-0)
ss-4-C1lME-OpyffNG87vQ.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 15
ss-4-C1lME-OpyffNG87vQ.description: Rendezvous with Operative Smith at the Warp Gate in Mitrilion.
ss-4-C1lME-OpyffNG87vQ.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Ok... well done… getting to this miserable system… it’s completely overrun by insects… especially those suicidal explosive moths… who even came up with that idea...? anyway… enough about the local fauna... let’s split up and cover all the planets.. I head west… you head east… start with Armoji and Orgasin...”

h1pxW6C-10i2pJJe9ePf_A.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 6 (0-0)
h1pxW6C-10i2pJJe9ePf_A.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 6
h1pxW6C-10i2pJJe9ePf_A.description: Return to Xhargregs Research Station in Zergilin with your findings.
h1pxW6C-10i2pJJe9ePf_A.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Why did you wake me up??? Oh, excellent, this is much more interesting.. But still not good enough. While you were slacking off killing those 888 ice-moths I did some real work and discovered that there are some extremely toxic Macrophages around the planet Pouleno. Go there and play with them a bit, won’t ya? Hehe…"

NI-B8UEhxkG_FaNu548eUQ.label: (PvP-3) More targets (2-0)
NI-B8UEhxkG_FaNu548eUQ.title: (PvP-3) More targets
NI-B8UEhxkG_FaNu548eUQ.description: Good job clearing those bounties! There seems to be an endless supply of people that think they can do whatever they want. It's time to go for the stronger targets. Go for any hostile players. Aim for the stronger ones this time, your target must be at least level 6.

KzRnZdtafUuOSOcwPSy5fw.label: Eldorado: Part 1 (0-0)
KzRnZdtafUuOSOcwPSy5fw.title: Eldorado: Part 1
KzRnZdtafUuOSOcwPSy5fw.description: We have recieved a distress call from the planet Sinensis here in Mitrillion. Please investigate and rescue any survivors.
KzRnZdtafUuOSOcwPSy5fw.completeDescription: John McClain: ”Ahh… finally. Thank you for helping me good Sir, I’m a John, John McClain, a pioneer in planetary excavations. Yes, I have already filled your ship to the brim with tools needed for this expidition. Haven’t you heard about the new system Fulzar, the legend says its a golden paradise, with planets made of solid gold! But no time for small talk, I have been waiting for this opportunity for years now.

DZFnoO53_Uibg3aKKsd9PQ.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 42 (0-0)
DZFnoO53_Uibg3aKKsd9PQ.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 42
DZFnoO53_Uibg3aKKsd9PQ.description: Join the assault and destroy the Aureus Executor!
DZFnoO53_Uibg3aKKsd9PQ.completeDescription: Admiral Ymer: “I can’t believe it! You did it! You are a true hero! Although our losses where heavy, this is great news! We have finally been able to deal a real blow to them! Maybe the settlers of New Erath can finally feel safe.”

yaG9ykyXhU2z81OG-T_wPg.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 39 (0-0)
yaG9ykyXhU2z81OG-T_wPg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 39
yaG9ykyXhU2z81OG-T_wPg.description: Collect 8000 pieces of Big Metal Scraps for the war effort!
yaG9ykyXhU2z81OG-T_wPg.completeDescription: Lieutenant Nguyen: “Take this reward as a token of appreciation for your assistance. Bring it to the resources to the recycle station in Fulzar.”

LP3PkPwg2ElDVhShshlZKJ.label: (timed): Fulzar Strongholds (100-0)
LP3PkPwg2ElDVhShshlZKJ.title: Fulzar Strongholds
LP3PkPwg2ElDVhShshlZKJ.description: Captain, the enemy is getting complacent. We cannot let them rebuild! Strike them where they will least expect it.. attack Anjio and then Mazim! You will be rewarded greatly.

TYs2gVcB8UmyxfXqtIvTQA.label: Exploration (2-0)
TYs2gVcB8UmyxfXqtIvTQA.title: Exploration
TYs2gVcB8UmyxfXqtIvTQA.description: Captain, we are gathering intelligence from all planets in the galaxy. You can take down a planet's defensive shield by destroying the spawners orbiting the planet. Then you may safely land and send down your teams.

zpQmhDjJfUqh7h_bfufjCQ.label: (timed): Infested Fanatics! (32-0)
zpQmhDjJfUqh7h_bfufjCQ.title: Infested Fanatics!
zpQmhDjJfUqh7h_bfufjCQ.description: Fanatics has always been a huge problem but now they are insane. They have been infested by an alien life form and is now roaming around in Sarkinon. Kill [amount] of them for us.

RZpxS5CJp0y486UMinTGrA.label: Bug Legs: Part 15 (0-0)
RZpxS5CJp0y486UMinTGrA.title: Bug Legs: Part 15
RZpxS5CJp0y486UMinTGrA.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Most facinating… I can’t wait to see the result of this experiment… Hehehehahahrgegeg… Whe wasps brought back another useless pile of glowing junk while you were gone… feel free to grab it.. I wonder why they do that anyway…”Crew: “More artifacts! Finally something useful!”Truly Gigantic Mutated Wasp: “Bzzzzzzz…?”Xhargreg: ”I seem to have run out of Genetic Control Implants… I need you to fetch a few more…”

Thir9psyTESCzdPtxZrkAA.label: (timed): Health Care! (23-0)
Thir9psyTESCzdPtxZrkAA.title: Health Care!
Thir9psyTESCzdPtxZrkAA.description: This is urgent, we need you to find and kill [amount] Repair Probes in Mitrillion. We have been told they can heal enemy ships, so try to isolate and take them out.

tcHbshJMe0uvQDacb7xPDg.label: (PvP-2) Law and order (2-0)
tcHbshJMe0uvQDacb7xPDg.title: (PvP-2) Law and order
tcHbshJMe0uvQDacb7xPDg.description: This Captain Mark C Tain from the Galactic Patrol. We've noticed your handy work, and approve of your methods. There has been a lot of unrest in the Antor System, innocent space explorers getting shot at for no reason. We've decided to issue a large bounty on the stronger hostile players in this sector. Take down 10 pirates above level 3, we don't care who you target as long as they are a threat to the peace. And remember... we don't show any mercy to pirate scum!

_BFcl9qGdE-D8FSwpyCqaA.label: The Infestation: Part 2 (0-0)
_BFcl9qGdE-D8FSwpyCqaA.title: The Infestation: Part 2
_BFcl9qGdE-D8FSwpyCqaA.description: Land on upgrade station and talk to Osho, the lead engineer.
_BFcl9qGdE-D8FSwpyCqaA.completeDescription: Osho could not thank us enough and told us that he is experimenting on a new weapon that will help them in their defense and he wants to share this technology with us. But they need some expert help in bio energy readings and asked if we can take some readings and travel to Ono, in the Kritillian sector. She have the knowledge to finish their new weapon.

4lUsmJwoBEqjDs2WScu_Dw.label: Junk is valuable (2-0)
4lUsmJwoBEqjDs2WScu_Dw.title: Junk is valuable
4lUsmJwoBEqjDs2WScu_Dw.description: When enemy ships are destroyed, the wreckage is left in space for other space travellers to pick up. This junk can be recycled into valuable resources. Captain, we need you to collect 20 units of scrap metal!

1ZIZLbE8ZEu3yFftru3Egg.label: (timed): Polueno Mission (16-0)
1ZIZLbE8ZEu3yFftru3Egg.title: Polueno Mission
1ZIZLbE8ZEu3yFftru3Egg.description: Go visit the planet Polueno and collect nesting data for future research on the Macrofag neural system. They are very tough and incredibly resilient.

mZsWmk4BUkunoD6w35aOjg.label: Upgrades (2-0)
mZsWmk4BUkunoD6w35aOjg.title: Upgrades
mZsWmk4BUkunoD6w35aOjg.description: Captain, we have allied upgrade stations placed around the galaxy. Press [h]'M'[/h] to locate the station in this system and go pay them a visit.

mDOOq_vucUyEjGu2ZCl4eQ.label: The Twins: Part 2 (0-0)
mDOOq_vucUyEjGu2ZCl4eQ.title: The Twins: Part 2
mDOOq_vucUyEjGu2ZCl4eQ.description: Head back to Endarion and tell them the bad news about their twin ship.
mDOOq_vucUyEjGu2ZCl4eQ.completeDescription: The settlers were very sad to lose their family and friends. But despite the dispair they seem to have found strength and promised each other to work hard to honour their beloved dead.

ZEngK-3yPk6R5hIMLnmasQ.label: New Lifeform: Part 10 (0-0)
ZEngK-3yPk6R5hIMLnmasQ.title: New Lifeform: Part 10
ZEngK-3yPk6R5hIMLnmasQ.description: For fun and possibly a few artifacts, land on Glictan and kidnap a renegade spy!
ZEngK-3yPk6R5hIMLnmasQ.completeDescription: Crew: “You really are crazy about those artifacts. But I guess the renegades deserve it after all..”

2PT_r6wlmUChgA5M0rEvXg.label: (timed): Massacre 3! (30-0)
2PT_r6wlmUChgA5M0rEvXg.title: Massacre 3!
2PT_r6wlmUChgA5M0rEvXg.description: Kill [amount] enemies of any kind. This one is really difficult so you need to be fast to beat it!

qdRZaxj1YE6OQSALTzeExw.label: (timed): DMAT Fighting! (35-0)
qdRZaxj1YE6OQSALTzeExw.title: DMAT Fighting!
qdRZaxj1YE6OQSALTzeExw.description: We have located a new type of fighter in Kritillian. It has a very strong armor and uses a new type of laser weapon. Kill 3 of them and see what you can find out about their weapon.

YqRoIgUDAkObvtGY8v9MyQ.label: (timed): Kill Blood Plankton! (20-0)
YqRoIgUDAkObvtGY8v9MyQ.title: Kill Blood Plankton!
YqRoIgUDAkObvtGY8v9MyQ.description: The regular plankton creatures have evolved and are more deadly than ever. Kill [amount] and recieve a reward.

KZveY-T0NUqBVQjF8auC-w.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 12 (0-0)
KZveY-T0NUqBVQjF8auC-w.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 12
KZveY-T0NUqBVQjF8auC-w.description: Go and *borrow* some bioengineering equipment from a Nezerian Battle Ship in Sarkinon.

R-VyY32lfU-XefcwVOqvcA.label: (timed): Kill the Spawners! (9-0)
R-VyY32lfU-XefcwVOqvcA.title: Kill the Spawners!
R-VyY32lfU-XefcwVOqvcA.description: The enemies are assembled inside the spawners. Help up take down [amount] of them captain!

oDNg0L6cJkalfRBB40M2mw.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 28 (0-0)
oDNg0L6cJkalfRBB40M2mw.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 28
oDNg0L6cJkalfRBB40M2mw.description: Crew: “Maybe we should locate Dr. Mira? She was able to translate the Nezerians logs last time.”Look for Dr. Mira at the Anchorhead Cantina in Durian.
oDNg0L6cJkalfRBB40M2mw.completeDescription: Bar Keeper: “Yeah, I remember her, she sure could handle her liquor. But she is not here any longer… she said something about a giant space brain… in some place called… what was it again.. oh right Neurona… if that’s even a real place”Nezerian Scientist: “Uhay nuur bar!”Bar Keeper: “Err… what? Who’s that guy?”Nezerian Scientist: “GHAARK!!!”Bar Keeper: “Ghaark to you too…. now either order something or… GET… LOST!"

kXjTL030wUGA8yMYOrfAHg.label: The Cult: Part 6 (0-0)
kXjTL030wUGA8yMYOrfAHg.title: The Cult: Part 6
kXjTL030wUGA8yMYOrfAHg.description: Jane: “Looks like we are in trouble, meet me at Melenda in Arrenius, also, I have someone else here that you might have a score to settle with.”
kXjTL030wUGA8yMYOrfAHg.completeDescription: Jane: “I knew I couldn't trust him so I waited for him at the warp gate while you recycled the engine parts. Then we had a serious talk and he confessed he is part of the Cult. According to the data the cult are experimenting on black holes and they are recruiting a small army of fanatics. My brother has been recruited as a fanatic purifier, they are know to attack and assassinate heretics in this system, I need to stop him”Cultist: “Hahahaha… It’s to late to save your brother and we knew you would fall for this trap, the planet has been surrounded by fanatics and now you will die, heretic!”

k2uJA5Am00K0KsZJQvP58w.label: The Cult: Part 1 (0-0)
k2uJA5Am00K0KsZJQvP58w.title: The Cult: Part 1
k2uJA5Am00K0KsZJQvP58w.description: We seem to have found a hitlist on a dead corpse. The only name that is not crossed over is Jane Hansen, according to the notes she is supposed to be a frequent drinker at the Anchorhead Cantina in Durian.
k2uJA5Am00K0KsZJQvP58w.completeDescription: Jane: “Who the hell are you? I'm not even close to being attracted to you, nor the right spieces.. so you're just here for a beer? Yeaaahhh... right... thats the worst lie I've heard today, and thats not saying a little...I bet those damn cult people sent you here to shut me up.. yes, they don't like me, they weren't that fond of my attempt to save my brother. Do you know what they do? You have never heard of them? Thats precisely what one of them would say.. but I actually need some help and I've the perfect mission for you, to prove you're not one of them, infiltrate their settlement and find a certain data chip... what I need it for? Thats not really your business, is it?”

lkD394JQaE-22Kwo6sSE5Q.label: Bounty Hunter Vorsran: Part 4 (0-0)
lkD394JQaE-22Kwo6sSE5Q.title: Bounty Hunter Vorsran: Part 4
lkD394JQaE-22Kwo6sSE5Q.description: Operative Smith: “The next mark is Captain Xhargrefh. This is going to be a lot more difficult. Captain Xhargref pilots an Elite Class Phaser vessel. The phaser is capable of completely negating energy resistances with it’s powerful Phaser beam weapon. The mark seems to prefer hit and run type of attacks. You might want to clear out any back up in the area before engaging this target. Captain Xhargrefh was last observed commanding the defences at the entrance to the third circle.”
lkD394JQaE-22Kwo6sSE5Q.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Unbelievable! You definitely earned the reward!”

CNBR5IlbOEGCcxmUAO8yDQ.label: Unknown Data: Part 7 (0-0)
CNBR5IlbOEGCcxmUAO8yDQ.title: Unknown Data: Part 7
CNBR5IlbOEGCcxmUAO8yDQ.description: We discovered some remaining notes hinting that the Renegades left for a hidden research facility somewhere in the Antor system.Perhaps we can find someone who knows more at the Crossfire Cantina in Arrenius
CNBR5IlbOEGCcxmUAO8yDQ.completeDescription: A suspicious looking insectoid lurking in a corner offered to sell us the coordinates of this secret renegade base. It requested that we scout a few planets and mark the locations of any valuable resources.Do you really think we can trust it?

ru8CI9pfXwes61rTr8NYPb.label: (timed): Assassination Plot (110-0)
ru8CI9pfXwes61rTr8NYPb.title: Assasination Plot
ru8CI9pfXwes61rTr8NYPb.description: The Nexar replace their admirals as fast as we can get people to kill them, see if you can throw them into confusion by taking out a few at once.

3H2_Va2C1EWvQwVT_y_FWw.label: Unknown Data: Part 5 (0-0)
3H2_Va2C1EWvQwVT_y_FWw.title: Unknown Data: Part 5
3H2_Va2C1EWvQwVT_y_FWw.description: We just received an emergency distress call from Jahaar on Centurion. Something has happened, we should return as fast as possible.
3H2_Va2C1EWvQwVT_y_FWw.completeDescription: Something happened to Jahaar While we were hunting the Stalkers. He is not linked to the net anymore. Rumors say he was kidnapped by the Renegades and taken to Vetinari in the Venturi star system. We should investigate this...

GYCWi2lZhUG3NMHQ_VJoFg.label: (timed): Livin' Through Chemistry (10-0)
GYCWi2lZhUG3NMHQ_VJoFg.title: Livin' Through Chemistry
GYCWi2lZhUG3NMHQ_VJoFg.description: Toxic waste is a precious product that can be recycled into plasma fluids, collect [amount] of those and you will receive a great reward.

PXHR15EJVEiOkKevcnbvTQ.label: Counter attack! - Part 12 (0-0)
PXHR15EJVEiOkKevcnbvTQ.title: Counter attack! - Part 12
PXHR15EJVEiOkKevcnbvTQ.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Excellent finally some progress! But… look at that thing they have constructed in here… their defences are truly impressive. Breaking through their defences is not going to be easy. Contact Admiral McArthur, at the Research Station here in Vorsran.”

hWmTB0NstkaDoaNf6fcS6Q.label: Eldorado: Part 9 (0-0)
hWmTB0NstkaDoaNf6fcS6Q.title: Eldorado: Part 9
hWmTB0NstkaDoaNf6fcS6Q.description: Bring John McClain to the surface of Lak so he can start the excavation.
hWmTB0NstkaDoaNf6fcS6Q.completeDescription: John McClain: “Thank you again! I will start excavating the surface and then go deeper into the core. My expedition crew are already set and if you want to explore some yourself, feel free to do so. Here is your final reward.”

LK83IvEV8E6QdOCFSgALLg.label: (timed): The Nexar Elite (100-0)
LK83IvEV8E6QdOCFSgALLg.title: The Nexar Elite
LK83IvEV8E6QdOCFSgALLg.description: The Nexar Elite is made up by the best fighters in the Nexar Fleet. The Edge type are fitted with a Heave Wave Generator, a dreadful siege weapon. They prefer to hide behind Nexar ships. So, make sure you clear out all support before engaging one of these.

YABEj84go0SqZ2Uaawi32A.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 10 (0-0)
YABEj84go0SqZ2Uaawi32A.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 10
YABEj84go0SqZ2Uaawi32A.description: Go to Vibrilian and kill 8 Deamons, be careful they can be a bit nasty

aoBSmgpVeky_-GMfBNFhow.label: (timed): Mission Impossible I (16-0)
aoBSmgpVeky_-GMfBNFhow.title: Mission Impossible I
aoBSmgpVeky_-GMfBNFhow.description: There are Elite Gunners guarding the planet [h]Graven[/h] in the Arrenius system. Kill [amount] of them for us. Also, there is a rumour that some of them can drop the gatling gun.

-UnfXRveyEupGd4m82fxqQ.label: The Infestation: Part 6 (0-0)
-UnfXRveyEupGd4m82fxqQ.title: The Infestation: Part 6
-UnfXRveyEupGd4m82fxqQ.description: Get up close and kill the Queen in the center of the Zergilin solar system and then let Ono do her research on the carcass.
-UnfXRveyEupGd4m82fxqQ.completeDescription: Captain, we have disturbing news, Ono has found out that the Queen is not responsible for its own actions, it is being mind controlled by something else. The energy readings from the Queen and the mechanical nano robots found inside the carcass indicates that something very unnatural is going on.

fNvi6z1pkEOhrv-N6Fd5pg.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 31 (0-0)
fNvi6z1pkEOhrv-N6Fd5pg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 31
fNvi6z1pkEOhrv-N6Fd5pg.description: Report to Admiral Cheng in Arrenius.
fNvi6z1pkEOhrv-N6Fd5pg.completeDescription: Admiral Cheng: “This is terrible news and the timing couldn’t be much worse… except, I wonder who the golden ones are? Something even the Nezerians dread… That’s not a good sign. We have just launched a venture into Fulzar, in an attempt to find more habitable planets. I fear for the expeditions safety. Go to Fulzar! You must make haste… Contact Admiral Ymer in Fulzar. I will dispatch assistance as soon as possible.

uyBeT8AA1kuqldiFhL18Fw.label: Counter attack! - Part 14 (0-0)
uyBeT8AA1kuqldiFhL18Fw.title: Counter attack! - Part 14
uyBeT8AA1kuqldiFhL18Fw.completeDescription: Admiral McArthur: “Hmm…. that took longer than I expected… Maybe your reputation was a bit exaggerated? Anyway.. we got a lot of work to do here. The key to victory in any war is knowledge about the opponent. How do they operate? What are their strong points? Weak points? Habits?  Engage a couple of Skirmishers and Cluster bombers, and we’ll observe their behaviour from here.
uyBeT8AA1kuqldiFhL18Fw.description: Destroy 75 Nexar Stealth Bombers in Vorsran.

NbWNvoCBOEu2ijHGsJpfaA.label: The Infestation: Part 4 (0-0)
NbWNvoCBOEu2ijHGsJpfaA.title: The Infestation: Part 4
NbWNvoCBOEu2ijHGsJpfaA.completeDescription: According to Ono's latest research she has discovered that the Macrophagse are a vital part of the infestation. She wants to study them up close and she insists that we take her to Polueno in the Zergilin system.
NbWNvoCBOEu2ijHGsJpfaA.description: Kill 100 moths to decrease the infestation rate and help Ono in her research. She believes  something evil is behind the spread of the infestation and she wants to find out what it is.

JSFgDA0KYESEE4IcZVl9-w.title: (PvP) Your first player kill
JSFgDA0KYESEE4IcZVl9-w.description: Shoot down another player!You can turn hostile by clicking on the "Skull icon" in the middle of the main UI bar. This can only be done inside a "Safe-Zone" in all systems as long as your level is not too high.

_Dx02gGWWEml9Dq7eXQJxA.label: Bounty Hunter Vorsran: Part 5 (0-0)
_Dx02gGWWEml9Dq7eXQJxA.title: Bounty Hunter Vorsran: Part 5
_Dx02gGWWEml9Dq7eXQJxA.description: Operative Smith: “The next link in their chain of command is Commodore Herivis. He is in a Nexar Edge class ship. He managed to take out the whole scouting squadron with a single shot. It appears as if they finally have managed to mount of version of the Heavy Weave generator, the type that those nasty space station turrets are sporting, on a mobile vessel. The damage output of this craft is insane, whatever you do, do not get hit. Even if you use harden shields against it, your defences will be severely weakened for a long time. Herivis was last seen the entrance to the 4th circle.”

NPjNUp_rf0WXeEzU3FIVHg.label: Eternal Mission (100-0)
NPjNUp_rf0WXeEzU3FIVHg.title: Eternal Mission
NPjNUp_rf0WXeEzU3FIVHg.description: You have reached the end and are now a true Astroflux space pioneer. You are truly awesome. But the Astroflux universe is always expanding. Stay tuned for more!

2FkBUTfwsUyDjZNtoK9LUA.label: (timed): Kill the Beamers (9-0)
2FkBUTfwsUyDjZNtoK9LUA.title: Kill the Beamers
2FkBUTfwsUyDjZNtoK9LUA.description: The Beamers are slow but have a powerful energy beam that gets more powerful when the target is locked for some time. Help us take them out!

zcA_0E25nkCxXcKksKfXqQ.label: (timed): Blade Swarm (14-0)
zcA_0E25nkCxXcKksKfXqQ.title: Blade Swarm
zcA_0E25nkCxXcKksKfXqQ.description: Thorn Blades have been spotted in Kritillian, find them and exterminate them.

YALkgBTWjEKjmwTdjW1xXA.title: Data Collection 3!
YALkgBTWjEKjmwTdjW1xXA.description: We are in urgent need of an advanced data chip. Please pick up a new one so we can analyze it.

xYSdUtHwJEexABLv5iQQWw.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 5 (0-0)
xYSdUtHwJEexABLv5iQQWw.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 5
xYSdUtHwJEexABLv5iQQWw.description: Find and kill an insectoid queen somewhere in the Gellan Sector.
xYSdUtHwJEexABLv5iQQWw.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “You are indeed quite skilled… not a wasted of time… make haste… return to the Warp Gate in Kritillian… I have uncovered some potentially valuable intel.”

8LZN40AXrkePTVyDst7lZQ.label: Questions about that past: Part 8 (0-0)
8LZN40AXrkePTVyDst7lZQ.title: Questions about that past: Part 8
8LZN40AXrkePTVyDst7lZQ.description: A blackmarket transporter called “Mark” recently had a run in with a mysterious battle ship. He’s currently trying to get his ship repaired at Ronduria, let’s head over there and find out what he knows.
8LZN40AXrkePTVyDst7lZQ.completeDescription: Mark: “Oh great… yet another bounty hunter.. don’t move an inch or I’ll blast you full of holes!You’re not here for my bounty? Ok… I guess I’ll take your word for it.. I hate to admit it, but I’m not in a great situation here.. with my ride in pieces… I won’t be able to leave this heap of junk for at least another month. So what do ya want?Ok, I’ll help ya out if you can get me the parts I need to get my ride going again. Grab 250 scrap metal, 50 barrels of hydrogen spill and some duct tape of course. That should do the trick…”

hho8H8xUNUR3m2jdQhxNN9.label: (timed): Assault the Executor (110-0)
hho8H8xUNUR3m2jdQhxNN9.title: Assault the Executor
hho8H8xUNUR3m2jdQhxNN9.description: The Aureus seem to rebuild their motherships at extreme speeds...it's a marvel that they can still function as an army. Defeat the Executor, kill off their high command and see if that cripples them.

ItHsfl0M_Ue0o0KRa8wJvQ.label: (timed): Nezerian Takedown (40-0)
ItHsfl0M_Ue0o0KRa8wJvQ.title: Nezerian Takedown
ItHsfl0M_Ue0o0KRa8wJvQ.description: Sarkinon is dominated by a Nezerian fleet, we need to take down [amount] battleships to prevent them from taking over the sector.

PxX9EDF5lkefNO6iSc6RjA.label: Questions about that past: Part 6 (0-0)
PxX9EDF5lkefNO6iSc6RjA.title: Questions about that past: Part 6
PxX9EDF5lkefNO6iSc6RjA.description: Drop Dr. Mira off at the Anchorhead Cantina in Durian.
PxX9EDF5lkefNO6iSc6RjA.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “I’ll ask around here, haha, don’t worry about me.. I can take care of myself if needed. In the meantime, find out the strength of the hostiles in the vicinity.

7a5XSn0ko0atqgFGgCgqbA.label: Counter attack! - Part 28 (0-0)
7a5XSn0ko0atqgFGgCgqbA.title: Counter attack! - Part 28
7a5XSn0ko0atqgFGgCgqbA.description: Return with the news to Admiral McArthur at the Vorsran Research Station.
7a5XSn0ko0atqgFGgCgqbA.completeDescription: Admiral McArthur: ”That’s terrible news. I guess that ruined the chance of ever getting ending this war. Leave me... I need some time to think.“

UITRxFDHJ062qvGy1re_og.label: Counter attack! - Part 5 (0-0)
UITRxFDHJ062qvGy1re_og.title: Counter attack! - Part 5
UITRxFDHJ062qvGy1re_og.description: You recognized that special kind of alien species very well, you have definitely encountered one before. You feel you better go talk to Xhargreg, right away.Xhargreg was last seen at the Abandoned Factory in Fulzar
UITRxFDHJ062qvGy1re_og.completeDescription: Giant Mutated Wasp: “Bzzzzz!”Crew: “Eeeek! Not again! Please, Captain let’s go somewhere else?” Giant Mutated Wasp: *sad bzzz*

MTxQhi044ESVeSzFXH5XEg.label: The Infestation: Part 8 (0-0)
MTxQhi044ESVeSzFXH5XEg.title: The Infestation: Part 8

MTxQhi044ESVeSzFXH5XEg.completeDescription: We successfully destroyed the Motherbrain but there is no indication of any change on infestation. It's apparent from the remnants that the Motherbrain indeed was created by the Nezerians, however it must have been a failure as it was completely out of control.

rM_WsN2SkkWWAC6EWZIkoQ.label: (timed): Zap-zap-zap! (37-0)
rM_WsN2SkkWWAC6EWZIkoQ.title: Zap-zap-zap!
rM_WsN2SkkWWAC6EWZIkoQ.description: Captain, we need you to kill [amount] of Nezerian fighters in Sarkinon. Please do it quickly!

faGQXJTIY02pXylGTt24Hw.label: The New Frontier: Part 6 (0-0)
faGQXJTIY02pXylGTt24Hw.title: The New Frontier: Part 6
faGQXJTIY02pXylGTt24Hw.description: Collect 10 bionic implants that is going to be used for research.
faGQXJTIY02pXylGTt24Hw.completeDescription: Agent ace: “Hmm… that took a long time, but at least you’re still alive. I was afraid we had lost yet another pilot. The bionic implants are extremely important and we thank you for the effort. As a reward, take these resources and invest them wisely in upgrades. There also a few spare artifacts in the armory. You will need it!”

BxmaAMS8k0-FjglEewCEgQ.label: (timed): Brain Dead (22-0)
BxmaAMS8k0-FjglEewCEgQ.title: Brain Dead
BxmaAMS8k0-FjglEewCEgQ.description: Bloody macrophages have been known to scramble the human brains of those who are not careful. Stay long enough in the poison and you will go crazy.

O7If7JmcY0iyGf1YcOZaeg.label: (timed): Kill the Launcher! (5-0)
O7If7JmcY0iyGf1YcOZaeg.title: Kill the Launcher!
O7If7JmcY0iyGf1YcOZaeg.description: There is a Launcher protecting Dustla. This enemy carries powerful missiles that penetrate our armor. Take it down!

zNhe7EvwDk-uh_QVxSQKng.label: A New Beginning: Part 4  (0-0)
zNhe7EvwDk-uh_QVxSQKng.title: A New Beginning: Part 4
zNhe7EvwDk-uh_QVxSQKng.description: Destroy hostile ships and salvage as much as you can, about 50 pieces of Metal Scrap should be a good start. Lieutenant Kreiger promised to get us a good deal on metal junk.
zNhe7EvwDk-uh_QVxSQKng.completeDescription: Lieutenant Kreiger: “I managed to negotiate a special deal on the junk, if you go to the Antor Federation Smelting Plant you’ll get at least twice the normal rate.“

Yh_x4t3Jgkm7l6WxFQveFQ.label: Endless Invasions (0-0)
Yh_x4t3Jgkm7l6WxFQveFQ.title: Endless Invasions
Yh_x4t3Jgkm7l6WxFQveFQ.description: Lieutenant John: "Hyperion is under attack by slavers. Please help us defend civilians on Erath by destroy ing 35 slavers.  Beware, they constantly get reinforcements from the outskirts of this solarsystem. "
Yh_x4t3Jgkm7l6WxFQveFQ.completeDescription: Lieutenant John: "Good work captain, we have rescued a lot of civilians that had been captured. I hope these resources will do as payment."

8mD3xdgr10Gpa6gOcBxMwA.label: New Lifeform: Part 13 (0-0)
8mD3xdgr10Gpa6gOcBxMwA.title: New Lifeform: Part 13
8mD3xdgr10Gpa6gOcBxMwA.description: Give the nearly-exploding dread moth larva to the sponge for dinner.
8mD3xdgr10Gpa6gOcBxMwA.completeDescription: Intelligent Sponge: “btza zzaa z”Krux: “baa z zz zzartz”Intelligent Sponge: *Gulp**EXPLOSION*Krux: *shocked*Crew: “Err… I think we just killed the sponge. Krux seem okay though, although somewhat disoriented maybe, we should take him home again.”

V0gWiU2QxUGTeol_8NaI-g.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 20 (0-0)
V0gWiU2QxUGTeol_8NaI-g.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 20
V0gWiU2QxUGTeol_8NaI-g.description: Bring the Renegade Defector to the small planet located at the coordinates x: 887, y: 220 in Vibrilian.
V0gWiU2QxUGTeol_8NaI-g.completeDescription: Renegade Defector: “Thank you! I’m finally safe again. So, what do you want to know? You want to find the Nezerians? Why? Are you insane..?? Ok Ok… I’ll tell you everything I know. The Nezerians have an outpost in Sarkinon. We, the Renegades used to be the AF Black Ops Division. Only few hundreds of survived the massacre in Azuron. We will never forget what we saw that day. The Renegades are sworn to take revenge on the accursed Nezerians. To end their miserable existence and avenge all our fallen comrades. The difference in strength was just too great… we decided to give up anything in order to obtain power. But recently they have gone to far. I can’t put a blind eye to it any longer.. I didn’t mind the stealing… but the torture, the countless murders and the horrific experiments. Everything just to get a technological advantage against the damned Nezerians. There is one more thing you should know… the reason the Nezerians came to Azuron… it was not for us… slaughtering our fleets was just a pastime while they waited… for the golden ones...”

YJbcm2fJakOSXGI_6fhLJQ.label: (timed): Alpha Hunt Hozar (12-0)
YJbcm2fJakOSXGI_6fhLJQ.title: Alpha Hunt Hozar
YJbcm2fJakOSXGI_6fhLJQ.description: There is a large moth nest in Hozar. Please kill [amount] alphas and you will be greatly rewarded.

_4TLz9IKW0mIMPkZFK-ihQ.label: (timed): Nexar Cluster (90-0)
_4TLz9IKW0mIMPkZFK-ihQ.title: Nexar Cluster
_4TLz9IKW0mIMPkZFK-ihQ.description: As with other Nexar fighter types these also have short range but possess powerful weaponary. Keep your distance and shoot it down by kiting. Be careful not to approach it while having other Nexars on your tail.

C-Ok-jD6X0WjnH2gkz44QA.label: (timed): Nexar “Nuke” Threat (92-0)
C-Ok-jD6X0WjnH2gkz44QA.title: Nexar “Nuke” Threat
C-Ok-jD6X0WjnH2gkz44QA.description: Upon entering Vorsran we have discovered an alien spacecraft equipped with cloaking technology and a type of nuke, we call it the Nexar Bomb. To secure our presence here we need to keep those things off the base or they will blow us apart and possibly even break our safe zone shield.

4WbYcvj2wEK22ZF-bmdeUw.label: (timed): Kill the Launchers! (9-0)
4WbYcvj2wEK22ZF-bmdeUw.title: Kill the Launchers!
4WbYcvj2wEK22ZF-bmdeUw.description: The Launchers are equipped with a powerful homing missile launcher that can deal great amounts of damage. Take them down, fast!

PCEzEiS-mUuGtqjX8blBeQ.label: Reach Level 30 (30-0)
PCEzEiS-mUuGtqjX8blBeQ.title: Reach Level 30
PCEzEiS-mUuGtqjX8blBeQ.description: You are truly one of a kind! Only a few have shown us this kind of progress and devotion. We need your loyalty, Captain. Are you on our side?

A9ag_G5YME2F7iLhCul6Tw.label: (timed): Thorn Ambush (10-0)
A9ag_G5YME2F7iLhCul6Tw.title: Thorn Ambush
A9ag_G5YME2F7iLhCul6Tw.description: Jagged Stars have been found all over the Gellan quadrant. Weed them out and you will be rewared.

jZbPsTJRvES4I70DGVTjIw.label: Unknown Data: Part 4 (0-0)
jZbPsTJRvES4I70DGVTjIw.title: Unknown Data: Part 4
jZbPsTJRvES4I70DGVTjIw.description: Jahaar agreed to create the weapon for you, but only if you help him gethering data on the Elite Stalkers in the Hyperion system. They have hindered him in his quest for new technologies long enough and he wants to know how they can be defeated. Obtain this data by killing 3 Elite Stalkers in Hyperion.
jZbPsTJRvES4I70DGVTjIw.completeDescription: We just received an emergency distress call from Jahaar on Centurion. Something has happened...

vP5tu0ucbUCtqPPb8G8JMw.label: (timed): Fanatic Invasion (11-0)
vP5tu0ucbUCtqPPb8G8JMw.title: Fanatic Invasion
vP5tu0ucbUCtqPPb8G8JMw.description: [player], we have discovered a Fanatic outpost in Kritillian. We have to elminate them before they can fortify their positions. Complete the mission and we will transfer the reward immediately.

lx0dTYgQBkmSBvP9T6Wrsg.label: Eldorado: Part 7 (0-0)
lx0dTYgQBkmSBvP9T6Wrsg.title: Eldorado: Part 7
lx0dTYgQBkmSBvP9T6Wrsg.description: Pick up 10 Polyhedric Fabric that we can trade for steel.
lx0dTYgQBkmSBvP9T6Wrsg.completeDescription: John McClain: “Ahh… yes, this is a spectacular material, its impervious to all kinds of energy weapons and almost impenetrable by physical force. No wonder the Aureus dominate this region of space. Ohh.. I almost forgot your share.Now.. I have heard that rumours about an abstract kind of energy ship that the Aureus can project. When they are destroyed the projection oscillators sometimes stay intact. I would really love to get hold of one of those. Bring me with you and let me handle the tractor beam..”

Dhu-fLNJM0WBo-sAqN0I4Q.label: Questions about that past: Part 9 (0-0)
Dhu-fLNJM0WBo-sAqN0I4Q.title: Questions about that past: Part 9
Dhu-fLNJM0WBo-sAqN0I4Q.description: Gather some materials to help Mark fix his ship, 350 pieces of scrap metal should be enough.

kZQKndcdU0C5-00wLBRN1g.label: Questions about that past: Part 5 (0-0)
kZQKndcdU0C5-00wLBRN1g.title: Questions about that past: Part 5
kZQKndcdU0C5-00wLBRN1g.description: Return to Dr. Mira on Rocky in Kapello.
kZQKndcdU0C5-00wLBRN1g.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “That sounds very ominous, we really have to discover what happened and who the attackers were. Maybe Hyperion is next? Or perhaps we are? All we know is that the warp gate in the system was destroyed in the battle. No signals have been received from Azuron for the last three years. I’ve scoured this entire system by now there are now more clues here. We should head to Durian next. Drop me off at the Anchorhead Cantina.

ESe6TvYQXkGq0eEqxseLdg.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 32 (0-0)
ESe6TvYQXkGq0eEqxseLdg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 32
ESe6TvYQXkGq0eEqxseLdg.description: Make your way to Fulzar and contact Admiral Ymer.
ESe6TvYQXkGq0eEqxseLdg.completeDescription: Admiral Ymer “Yes, the situation here is bad. Although not as bad as it could have been. The Nezerians and the Aureus, so called the ‘Golden Ones’ are too busy fighting each other to bother with us. Contact Operative Smith, I think he’s got a plan… and if I know him by now it will certainly involve a kidnapping”

ZBhB4QEZD0myQkv4vhvQLg.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 26 (0-0)
ZBhB4QEZD0myQkv4vhvQLg.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 26
ZBhB4QEZD0myQkv4vhvQLg.description: Kidnap an Nezerian Scientist from the Nezerian Research facility located at the coordinates x: -291 y: 683 in Sarkinon.
ZBhB4QEZD0myQkv4vhvQLg.completeDescription: Nezerian Scientist: “Nahgreh zarreph ghaark! GHAARK! GHAARK!”

WWtaGbRKBUuhG_wz8AoyIg.label: (timed): Ice Breaker (11-0)
WWtaGbRKBUuhG_wz8AoyIg.title: Ice Breaker
WWtaGbRKBUuhG_wz8AoyIg.description: We have discovered moths with freeze acid. Please find them and eliminate [amount] for a good cause.

pg5WBIdY0E-TXPxYCftvkQ.label: Counter attack! - Part 9 (0-0)
pg5WBIdY0E-TXPxYCftvkQ.title: Counter attack! - Part 9
pg5WBIdY0E-TXPxYCftvkQ.description: Report back to Operative Smith in Fulzar.
pg5WBIdY0E-TXPxYCftvkQ.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “This was unexpected news... and potentially very useful… Since you already know someone of this species… you will have to follow this up. Your new mission is to find out more about this new species from your contact Xhargreg. What’s this species called? Where do they attack from? What are their weaknesses?”

BfDsvCUpkUSDRUcqBKp4hA.label: (timed): The Evil Stalkers (5-0)
BfDsvCUpkUSDRUcqBKp4hA.title: The Evil Stalkers
BfDsvCUpkUSDRUcqBKp4hA.description: We can't guarantee the safety of space travellers with this many Stalkers around. Help us take them down. And please Captain, do it fast, we have had too many casualties already...

g_wDcIUesEaIYo67n5bIvw.label: Stolen Technology: Part 3 (0-0)
g_wDcIUesEaIYo67n5bIvw.title: Stolen Technology: Part 3
g_wDcIUesEaIYo67n5bIvw.description: Land on Eufelion and Axalon to look for clues about those responsbile for the raid on Arborea.
g_wDcIUesEaIYo67n5bIvw.completeDescription: Captain, we have found something interesting. The three infested planets seem to act as an emitter relay that distort our sensors.  However, we found weak signal indicating a hidden station in this system.We should head for those coordinates.

YeJI8yDtH0m_kUJSAPRlSw.label: (timed): Kill the Beamer! (6-0)
YeJI8yDtH0m_kUJSAPRlSw.title: Kill the Beamer!
YeJI8yDtH0m_kUJSAPRlSw.description: There is a nasty Beamer orbiting Illion in Durian, please help us take it down Captain [player]!

0ePpNm6SoEC4f2CH-B7KKQ.label: Counter attack! - Part 21 (0-0)
0ePpNm6SoEC4f2CH-B7KKQ.title: Counter attack! - Part 21
0ePpNm6SoEC4f2CH-B7KKQ.description: Bring the scan data to the AF Research station located next to the Vorsran Warp Gate.
0ePpNm6SoEC4f2CH-B7KKQ.completeDescription: AF Scientist: “Most interesting, the planet lacks an atmosphere and any breathable gasses… quite the harsh environment for living on. This probably means that the Nexar doesn’t use sound for communication. Perhaps this explains why they haven’t answered any of our communication attempts. Strange… I read your report about Xhargreg… seems like he was able to speak. Anyway back to the war… Admiral McArthur requested that you assist in capturing the Nexar Recycle station located in the 2nd ring.”

kU1fOWORVEyMUYIwT7XiIQ.label: Counter attack! - Part 2 (0-0)
kU1fOWORVEyMUYIwT7XiIQ.title: Counter attack! - Part 2
kU1fOWORVEyMUYIwT7XiIQ.description: Operative Smith: “Bring the remains to the AFIS HQ station in Arrenius, perhaps they can reconstruct an image of what it used to look like… before you blew it up.”
kU1fOWORVEyMUYIwT7XiIQ.completeDescription: AF Agent: “What have you got for us this time? Really???? You want me to do what??  Sigh.. I wonder why I signed up for this line of work.Okok… I’ll get to work.. To complete this task I’ll need some supplies from the AF Research Station here in Arrenius.“

Paciifau4EGeoDB19E4oLw.label: The Cult: Part 3 (0-0)
Paciifau4EGeoDB19E4oLw.title: The Cult: Part 3
Paciifau4EGeoDB19E4oLw.description: Go back to the Anchorhead Cantina and give Jane the data chip. Beware of any ambush attempts from the Cult.
Paciifau4EGeoDB19E4oLw.completeDescription: Jane: "Pssst... Yeees, that is a sharp edge on your throat.. Did anyone follow you here? .... now, show me the data chip. Hmm... I need to take this to a friend of mine to decode the data. I will stay in hiding here while you take the data chip to my friend. The situation is very tense around here after you stole from the cultist's, we have a bounty on our head now.. they only care about their beliefs and would not hesitate to kill us both to protect it."

Pnz5Fn1mLEKZn_bPHCXoAA.label: Another Dimension: Part 4 (0-0)
Pnz5Fn1mLEKZn_bPHCXoAA.title: Another Dimension: Part 4
Pnz5Fn1mLEKZn_bPHCXoAA.description: Lieutenant Reiland: "We have bad news, Abraham is an imposter that infiltrated our command structure. He managed to trick us into believing the Renegades were experimenting with a weapon of mass destruction when they actually were trying to prevent the black hole from expanding. I will explain more once you come to the warp gate in Kapello.
Pnz5Fn1mLEKZn_bPHCXoAA.completeDescription: Lieutenant Reiland: "I am truly surprised, Abraham was one of our best Lieutenants. But his betrayal will not go unpunished.Our internal investigation indicates he is a fanatic priest and a double agent to the fanatics. His mission was to unleash the "true gods" into the Antor System. Their goal is to put fear and terror into everyday citizens to make them believe in god.We need you to hunt down Abraham and punish him for his treason."

NDikiN7H6Ue1ld02xWwnZA.label: The Infestation: Part 9 (0-0)
NDikiN7H6Ue1ld02xWwnZA.title: The Infestation: Part 9
NDikiN7H6Ue1ld02xWwnZA.description: Ono was very disappointed  that the infestation rate didn't change. However, she asked if we could do her a last favour and drop her off at the Hangar near the Nezerian invasion force in Sarkinon.
NDikiN7H6Ue1ld02xWwnZA.completeDescription: Ono thanked us one last time and told us to give this data chip to Osho. He knows what to do with it. Also, she wanted us to tell Osho she is sorry about what happened and that she can't go back now.

lZMg4Z6q4EmKxpVZvSczOw.label: (timed): Hive Metal! (76-0)
lZMg4Z6q4EmKxpVZvSczOw.title: Hive Metal!
lZMg4Z6q4EmKxpVZvSczOw.description: Kill a Bionic Queen and help the federation to combat this nasty enemy. The reward is great!

cFAeMXeh6EOiW6izNaMNtg.label: New Lifeform: Part 4 (0-0)
cFAeMXeh6EOiW6izNaMNtg.title: New Lifeform: Part 4
cFAeMXeh6EOiW6izNaMNtg.description: Travel to Aladivin in Sarkinon and collect Amygdala Ooze.
cFAeMXeh6EOiW6izNaMNtg.completeDescription: Crew: “Captain, we have the Ooze secured in our cargo hold. It’s a really juicy organism, I wonder what the sponge wants to do with it.”

HZnxolWixEKxihfPfM4ZWQ.label: (timed): Bionic Macropahes! (70-0)
HZnxolWixEKxihfPfM4ZWQ.title: Bionic Macropahes!
HZnxolWixEKxihfPfM4ZWQ.description: They are similar to the macrophages at Polueno, but this time they have a bionic shield and are even tougher.

Q8JJ9Dh-bUOat0NvDEX81A.label: (timed): Anti-fighter! (65-0)
Q8JJ9Dh-bUOat0NvDEX81A.title: Anti-fighter!
Q8JJ9Dh-bUOat0NvDEX81A.description: Destroy [amount] Nezerian fighters in Fulzar and helpt the federation to secure its territory against the Nezerian faction.

c0PgupPXr06voBbVkgvDvw.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 6 (0-0)
c0PgupPXr06voBbVkgvDvw.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 6
c0PgupPXr06voBbVkgvDvw.description: Go to the Warp Gate in Kritillian.
c0PgupPXr06voBbVkgvDvw.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Apart from the insectoids there are two sentient factions present in this area… they might be able to serve as a useful source of intel… the so called ‘Fanatics’ and the ‘Renegades’... lets flip coins on who get what… *flips a coin*... oh.. lucky… you get the Fanatics… go kidnap a Fanatic Pilot… and bring him to the AFIS HQ in Arrenius… for further processing”

CjDPx9RfQEy7G04J4_T6Yg.label: The New Frontier: Part 4 (0-0)
CjDPx9RfQEy7G04J4_T6Yg.title: The New Frontier: Part 4
CjDPx9RfQEy7G04J4_T6Yg.description: Talk to and assist Agent Ace at the upgrade station.
CjDPx9RfQEy7G04J4_T6Yg.completeDescription: Agent Ace: “Ah… we have a new fellow in our ranks. Do you even know what you are up against? …. I thought so. To achieve anything meningful we need to use guerilla tactics, we can’t just attack the Nezerians head on, they are much to powerful for that. Instead we have to pick them off one by one before we can strike against one of their battle stations. Also, they have polyhedric coating that gives them full resistance against corrosive weapons and a strong kinetic plating, so I would strongly advice you to use energy weapons.You can start by attacking a few Nezerian fighters at the outer region. You should be familiar with them already so they should be an easy target.”

RCGVxrpCv0ahbIZXzqdhXw.label: (timed): The Nexar Elite (100-0)
RCGVxrpCv0ahbIZXzqdhXw.title: The Nexar Elite
RCGVxrpCv0ahbIZXzqdhXw.description: The Nexar Elite is made up by the best fighters in the Nexar Fleet. Nothing is known about the Shadow type. No one sent after a Shadow have ever returned…

ef6dxvqLo0OpoFySIm1CMQ.label: (timed): Seeker and Destroy (6-0)
ef6dxvqLo0OpoFySIm1CMQ.title: Seeker and Destroy
ef6dxvqLo0OpoFySIm1CMQ.description: The Seekers are keeping us from accessing the surface of planets in the Kapello and Hyperion systems. Help us hunt them now, Captain!

nnwuHjPCeE2IKnjHVm_zWg.label: (timed): Elite Triad Destruction (12-0)
nnwuHjPCeE2IKnjHVm_zWg.title: Elite Triad Destruction
nnwuHjPCeE2IKnjHVm_zWg.description: Captain, we need to destroy a group of elite Triads. They were last seen around the planet of Daren. Be careful, it is not an easy mission.

OCwtqeX7pk25zsbRYXY2MQ.label: (timed): Recycle [amount] (10-0)
OCwtqeX7pk25zsbRYXY2MQ.title: Recycle [amount]
OCwtqeX7pk25zsbRYXY2MQ.description: Shooting stuff down is all fun and games, but we also need to keep it real and clean. It's time you show us some responsibility and recycle [amount] units of Big Metal Scrap.

OMkUr1Og-0O3rjFXHYTpfQ.label: Bug Legs: Part 14 (0-0)
OMkUr1Og-0O3rjFXHYTpfQ.title: Bug Legs: Part 14
OMkUr1Og-0O3rjFXHYTpfQ.description: Xhargreg: ”I have an excellent idea.. I need you to bring me a few samples of brain tissue from that failure in Neurona…”*Collect 8 Samples of Brain Tissue from the Mother Brain in Neurona*
OMkUr1Og-0O3rjFXHYTpfQ.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Hurry back! We are on the brink of a breakthrough here! Hahaharrhrgheheh…”

F9TQ-kpWhE2VnXC2J7GRrQ.label: Enemy takedown (1-0)
F9TQ-kpWhE2VnXC2J7GRrQ.title: Enemy takedown
F9TQ-kpWhE2VnXC2J7GRrQ.description: Welcome to the chaos, Captain! We need your help, take down [h]10[/h] enemies of any kind and receive a well deserved reward.Have funsies!

rJAIaMd6F0K5in2emqL_bg.label: (PvP-7) A new weapon (2-0)
rJAIaMd6F0K5in2emqL_bg.title: (PvP-7) A new weapon
rJAIaMd6F0K5in2emqL_bg.description: Since you managed to join us in the Blood-Claw band ... we've got a piece of information for you ... We've finally managed to complete a brand new and brutal weapon: The Blood-Claw S28 Smart Gun. It excells at killing small maneuverable ships. If you can manage to gain 5000 rep ... we'll share this technology with you. It's a tough task ... but if you can manage, it should be well worth the effort!

ylxvb8KNTU6EQOdiBomyIQ.label: Counter attack! - Part 4 (0-0)
ylxvb8KNTU6EQOdiBomyIQ.title: Counter attack! - Part 4
ylxvb8KNTU6EQOdiBomyIQ.completeDescription: AF Agent: “That was fast.. sigh.. I guess I have to get on with reconstructing the corpse then…”Several hours laterAF Agent: “This is the best I can do… Oh? You think recognize this species? I didn’t expect that. Who is this Xhargreg you speak of?”Go search for Xhargreg at the Abandoned Factory in Fulzar

GHOUVDJTwk20uqAUNGHoMA.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 30 (0-0)
GHOUVDJTwk20uqAUNGHoMA.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 30
GHOUVDJTwk20uqAUNGHoMA.description: Return to AFIS HQ with the kidnapped Nezerian Scientist and Dr. Mira.Nezerian Scientist: “Fharg gak kraka zhur...”Dr. Mira: “Hmmm….”Nezerian Scientist: “Gak?”
GHOUVDJTwk20uqAUNGHoMA.completeDescription: Dr. Mira: “I can use the previous data I obtained from the Dominator to translate.”Nezerian Scientist:  “GHAARK!!!”Dr. Mira: “He said ‘HELP!!’”Operative Smith: “Tell him… ‘No.’”Dr. Mira: “Hurag hark”Nezerian Scientist: “Fharg gak kraka zhur. Harga nuur zharg kraka zherphek zhur...”Dr. Mira: “He said ‘Let me go, I don’t have time for this nonsense’”Nezerian Scientist: “Hujarh nur kjajarh…. Kark!”Dr. Mira: “You are insignificant… Worthless!”*2 hours laterOperative Smith: “Yawn… he won’t say anything useful... all we’ve found is that they don’t know who we are… and they most certainly don’t care… they just see us as target practise… he seems to really fear something… something they refer to only as... the golden ones.. somewhere inside Fulzar… you should report our findings to Admiral Cheng in Arrenius… they need to know what to prepare for...”

VJ5R08GtnkGyryu6LHNXzg.label: Counter attack! - Part 23 (0-0)
VJ5R08GtnkGyryu6LHNXzg.title: Counter attack! - Part 23
VJ5R08GtnkGyryu6LHNXzg.completeDescription: Admiral McArthur: “Well done! That was a really nasty enemy. Defeating the Nexar Elite is not going to be an easy task. There might be another option avilable... I have received the report based on your scan data. Apparently the Nexar are unable to use sound for communication. Perhaps it’s time for a new attempt at negotiating. For this we will need the help of that madman Xhargreg… please try to convince him to help us.”
VJ5R08GtnkGyryu6LHNXzg.description: Admiral McArthur: “A new threat have been reported, a force called the Nexar Elite is defending the inner circles. Your next task is to find and defeat a member of the Nexar Elite.”

wBhO2YQ-h0m14AF7JUkqdQ.label: (timed): Nexar Anti-repair (90-0)
wBhO2YQ-h0m14AF7JUkqdQ.title: Nexar Anti-repair
wBhO2YQ-h0m14AF7JUkqdQ.description: The repair probes have caused a lot of trouble for the federation in our attempt to reach the middle of the Vorsran system. They can be located in the inner rings and are difficult to track down. If you have the opportunity, please destroy them on sight.

7DJ-UPpGjUC8jb28ml1Zfw.label: (PvP) Reputation (2-0)
7DJ-UPpGjUC8jb28ml1Zfw.title: (PvP) Reputation
7DJ-UPpGjUC8jb28ml1Zfw.description: Get 5 more kills. When you kill someone in PvP combat you gain reputation. If you're hostile and attacking other neutral players you'll get 'Pirate Reputation' - on the other hand, if you're not hostile, or act in defence of others, you'll get 'Police Reputation'.

24xOuX7JTkaQvrkea11k9w.label: New Lifeform: Part 2 (0-0)
24xOuX7JTkaQvrkea11k9w.title: New Lifeform: Part 2
24xOuX7JTkaQvrkea11k9w.description: Land on Fexucius in Sarkinon and show Krux the recording of the new lifeform.
24xOuX7JTkaQvrkea11k9w.completeDescription: Krux: “Ohh.. you again, or maybe I mistake you for another one. I don’t see many bipedal species nowadays. But you have a very interesting recording I must say, last time I was on Barbulos the sponge was completely silent and it didn’t seem to be sentient at all. Something must have sparked its interest. You need to take me there!”

UCIH2CgM_0C47kx7MkSVhA.label: (timed): Bone Excavation! (30-0)
UCIH2CgM_0C47kx7MkSVhA.title: Bone Excavation!
UCIH2CgM_0C47kx7MkSVhA.description: The infamous Ossakel is a known space pirate and he was last spotted in the Kritilian system. Find and destroy his ship for us.

E9OFUwma40W-pfpsRcHlSg.label: Reach Level 35 (35-0)
E9OFUwma40W-pfpsRcHlSg.title: Reach Level 35
E9OFUwma40W-pfpsRcHlSg.description: We can see you're aiming for the top, and we like it! Your powers are increasing every minute. Reach this impressive level and we will make sure you are rewarded.

_BNLTsjP-kezK3sDK_wHDQ.label: Bug Legs: Part 1 (0-0)
_BNLTsjP-kezK3sDK_wHDQ.title: Bug Legs: Part 1
_BNLTsjP-kezK3sDK_wHDQ.description: Lieutenant Nguyen:  ”Captain, we received a message for you, unfortunately due to static interference we were just able to decode two words: ‘Bug’ and ‘Legs’. I wonder what that could possibly mean… well I don’t have time for this so I’ll leave it up to you to figure out.”“Find Xhargreg somewhere in Fulzar.”
_BNLTsjP-kezK3sDK_wHDQ.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”What took you so long? There’s an emergency of untold proportions unfolding here. The world is in dire need of saving! And you were busy doing… uhm… exactly… what? You must hurry! Head over to the Hozar system already, I will contact you again once you get to the Warp Gate.”

hmcp5cGiSEq962JcGaRqHg.label: (timed): Junk pickup (3-0)
hmcp5cGiSEq962JcGaRqHg.title: Junk pickup
hmcp5cGiSEq962JcGaRqHg.description: Don't leave the junk in space Captain, it can be recycled into refined minerals. Those minerals are essential when upgrading our ship.

ZN9zKVFaYm2F54IBDZF9uv.label: (timed): Design Effort 2(100-0)
ZN9zKVFaYm2F54IBDZF9uv.title: Design Effort 2
ZN9zKVFaYm2F54IBDZF9uv.description: Help us develop our Nezerian ship designs by gathering the necessary amount of Bionic Implants for the Prototypes.

rD08txb8-kmV_GTOeHKCag.label: Another Dimension: Part 1 (0-0)
rD08txb8-kmV_GTOeHKCag.title: Another Dimension: Part 1
rD08txb8-kmV_GTOeHKCag.description: AF Lieutenant Abraham: "Greetings captain, I really need your help. We have recieved information about a dangerous experiment run by the renegades. We are not completely sure what it is yet, but we need you to infiltrate the Renegade Stronghold on the planet Glictan in Zergilin. Hopefully we will find out what they are up to."
rD08txb8-kmV_GTOeHKCag.completeDescription: AF Lieutenant Abraham: "Perfect, tap into their central data bank and search for something related to "project nether". Our prediction is that they are trying to create a weapon of mass destruction.Did you find it? Yes... Thats it! You found what we were looking for. Take this small reward and wait for further instructions."

F0zidn8TEES9M0NBPGt1Cw.label: Unknown Data: Part 10 (0-0)
F0zidn8TEES9M0NBPGt1Cw.title: Unknown Data: Part 10
F0zidn8TEES9M0NBPGt1Cw.description: Land on the mysterious stataion and take back what's yours (in Durian at x = 415, y = -722). Reclaim the data chip with the weapon blueprints.
F0zidn8TEES9M0NBPGt1Cw.completeDescription: The renegades had just managed to finish the first prototype of a new weapon. Luckily we were able to liberate it!*hint: The weapon will be attached to your current ship.

MjJXE6FjxUujlsrZ-E5RMA.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 14 (0-0)
MjJXE6FjxUujlsrZ-E5RMA.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 14
MjJXE6FjxUujlsrZ-E5RMA.completeDescription: Black Market Merchant: “Thank you very very much! This will make my life a lot easier. I will keep my end of the bargain. The person you are looking for came past here a few days, I sold him a new ship and some replicated weapons. He was last seen warping to Mitrilion, he’s probably laying low on some planet there.”
MjJXE6FjxUujlsrZ-E5RMA.description: Assist the Black Market Merchant by killing 60 Moth Alphas in Hozar.

adD2AhOuRkSzHkV3WrO3xQ.label: A New Beginning: Part 5  (0-0)
adD2AhOuRkSzHkV3WrO3xQ.title: A New Beginning: Part 5
adD2AhOuRkSzHkV3WrO3xQ.description: Go to the Antor Federation Smelting Plant and recycle the junk, Lieutenant Kreiger promised that you’ll receive a big bonus.
adD2AhOuRkSzHkV3WrO3xQ.completeDescription: Lieutenant Kreiger: “By now you should have enough resources to upgrade some of your tech by now. Head over to the Antor Federation Research Station, I’ll ask them to share some of their know-how.”

i1ygwjfNTkaYCCVxZSQfKQ.label: Bug Legs: Part 4 (0-0)
i1ygwjfNTkaYCCVxZSQfKQ.title: Bug Legs: Part 4
i1ygwjfNTkaYCCVxZSQfKQ.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Now that the dreadful ‘bug leg crisis’ finally has been resolved... we can go back to the less important issues… have you by any chance noticed the situation in Fulzar?  The most distressing part... is... that there doesn’t seem to be any new bugs here... *sob*... I mean… what’s the use of exploring a new system if there are no bugs around? *sob* We should focus on resolving this issue...”

KYVSx-oQJEa-4_P44cFtNQ.label: Weapons Cartel: Part 4 (0-0)
KYVSx-oQJEa-4_P44cFtNQ.title: Weapons Cartel: Part 4
KYVSx-oQJEa-4_P44cFtNQ.description: AF Transmission: "The Graven stronghold in Arrenius has been the central node for an underground weapons cartel. We need you to eliminate the Elite Gunners and Elite Lanchers so that we can infiltrate it."
KYVSx-oQJEa-4_P44cFtNQ.completeDescription: AF Transmission: "It looks like we have found a few interesting things while you attacked Graven. Apparently the weapons are transported via Kapello.Its probably the supply line for all enemy strongholds in the Antor system. We need to put at stop to it."

8aiXE0pcCEylc1gLXDAQkQ.label: (timed): Massacre 1! (20-0)
8aiXE0pcCEylc1gLXDAQkQ.title: Massacre 1!
8aiXE0pcCEylc1gLXDAQkQ.description: Kill [amount] enemies of any kind. Just be quick and don't let the chat slow you down!

6BwOr3x1R0SicuNcrjXTGg.label: Counter attack! - Part 25 (0-0)
6BwOr3x1R0SicuNcrjXTGg.title: Counter attack! - Part 25
6BwOr3x1R0SicuNcrjXTGg.description: Xhargreg agreed to help for the low low price of 42 Bug Legs… What's he doing with all the Bug Legs anyway?
6BwOr3x1R0SicuNcrjXTGg.completeDescription: Return to Xhargreg in Fulzar with the Bug Legs!

Qxi_yqotjEWA1a89UTWk6Q.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 18

Qxi_yqotjEWA1a89UTWk6Q.completeDescription: Renegade Defector: “Here??? You think this place is safe? Not a chance!”AF Agent: “This is probably the safest place in the galaxy… for some at least… hehe…”Renegade Defector: “You clearly don’t know much… the Renegades will hunt me to the ends of the universe if they have to.. ”AF Agent: “Ingrateful! We could just interrogate you… we’ll have you talking in minutes...”Renegade Defector: “I’ll never talk… I would be dead either way”Operative Smith: “Let’s not get hastily here… specify your terms…“Renegade Defector: “Just find me a safe place to hide..”

-b61WhCbW0-9qV2QxTPqOg.label: Counter attack! - Part 3 (0-0)
-b61WhCbW0-9qV2QxTPqOg.title: Counter attack! - Part 3
-b61WhCbW0-9qV2QxTPqOg.description: To complete the task of reconstructing the corpse the AF Agent requires some supplies from the AF Research Station here in Arrenius.
-b61WhCbW0-9qV2QxTPqOg.completeDescription: Lieutenant Keryn: “Hi there hero! Long time no see. What’s Fulzar like?A supply request? Sure I’ll get the supplies you requested right away!”

bv_zEB9-80ieY1-498jsOA.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 33 (0-0)
bv_zEB9-80ieY1-498jsOA.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 33
bv_zEB9-80ieY1-498jsOA.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “Ah there you are… I have a cunning plan… “Crew Member: “Let me guess… you want us to kidnap an Aures Pilot?”Operative Smith: “How did you know about my top secret plan?”Crew Member: “It’s the same plan everytime!”Operative Smith: “Hrrrmmm… let’s just get on with it…”

8icjmmv1tkiZmKRsqhRQsg.label: Questions about that past: Part 15 (0-0)
8icjmmv1tkiZmKRsqhRQsg.title: Questions about that past: Part 15
8icjmmv1tkiZmKRsqhRQsg.description: Talk to Lieutenant Kreiger at the Antor Federation Armoury in Hyperion.
8icjmmv1tkiZmKRsqhRQsg.completeDescription: Lieutenant Kreiger: “That’s some really bad news you got there, a hostile alien race capable of warp travel without the use of warp gates… that means they could appear anywhere, anytime, without any warning. Thanks for the warning, I’ll spread this information to the remnants of the Antor Federation. We need to prepare for the worst… There’re still one questions remaining… and that’s the why… why did they attack Azuron?”

npBfW1Ho40KTpGv-bKpSLw.label: Reach Level 40 (40-0)
npBfW1Ho40KTpGv-bKpSLw.title: Reach Level 40
npBfW1Ho40KTpGv-bKpSLw.description: You are outstanding captain! We never expected you to become such an excellent leader with superb fighting and decision making skills. However, we still have yet another mission.

LTtEVCP7IUm_qk6vrlhSmg.label: A New Beginning: Part 8 (0-0)
LTtEVCP7IUm_qk6vrlhSmg.title: A New Beginning: Part 8
LTtEVCP7IUm_qk6vrlhSmg.description: Land on the planet and checks what’s going on.*Hint: Use the opportunity to scavenge the planet for minerals
LTtEVCP7IUm_qk6vrlhSmg.completeDescription: We arrived just in time, it seems like the slavers didn’t have time to land on the planet yet, everyone in the colony is safe!

NcYN_eZ_WkKf7XIpouZDlw.title: Recycle [amount]
NcYN_eZ_WkKf7XIpouZDlw.description: Recycle times! We need you to bring [amount] units of scrap to the recycle station, Captain.

kNjyeWk37EyXND0hxlnpKQ.label: Questions about that past: Part 1 (0-0)
kNjyeWk37EyXND0hxlnpKQ.title: Questions about that past: Part 1
kNjyeWk37EyXND0hxlnpKQ.description: Sergeant Reiland: “Welcome to Kapello, I’ve heard from Lieutenant Kreiger that you’re quite competent. Dr. Mira, a scientist and historian told me she wanted to talk to you about something. She’s apparently doing some research related to Azuron. If you’re interested, she is on Rocky in Kapello.”
kNjyeWk37EyXND0hxlnpKQ.completeDescription: We found Dr. Mira in an ice cave trying to communicate with some strange ice worms. Rather confusing ones… She quickly noticed us and abandoned the ice worms to rush over... Dr. Mira: “Just the one I’ve been looking for! Get over here, I’ve so much things to ask you. I hope you don’t mind if I record our conversation? For the records of course… You’re from Azuron, right? What happened back there? Common tell me already! I must know! You don’t know? Well now.. that’s really disappointing. Lately there has been so many refugees, something terrible must have happened? Do you remember anything apart from being under attack? Do you want to help me uncover the truth about Azuron?

C6Bsl6vRYEOXd_SGzqJd0g.label: Eldorado: Part 3 (0-0)
C6Bsl6vRYEOXd_SGzqJd0g.title: Eldorado: Part 3
C6Bsl6vRYEOXd_SGzqJd0g.description: Land on Oshos Upgrades in Arrenius and collect the money he owes John.
C6Bsl6vRYEOXd_SGzqJd0g.completeDescription: John McClain: "The next guy that owes can be quite tricky to find. He is a missing AF Agent that was last seen on the planet Vlardenon in the Sarkinon system."

sOvkDqGKqEG5S6NcV8MPOA.label: Bug Legs: Part 10 (0-0)
sOvkDqGKqEG5S6NcV8MPOA.title: Bug Legs: Part 10
sOvkDqGKqEG5S6NcV8MPOA.description: ”Kill 32 Renegade Spies and collect samples from their Corrosive Missiles”
sOvkDqGKqEG5S6NcV8MPOA.completeDescription: Crew: “we received a message from Xhargreg, it goes something like: ‘Bzzzz! Bzzzz! BZZZZ!!!’”Crew: “Maybe we should return and check if Xhargreg is ok…”Crew: “or run away to a guaranteed wasp free place…”

5UzAJvfO3kCzRg6wQ96Lqw.label: An Unknown Threat: Part 19 (0-0)
5UzAJvfO3kCzRg6wQ96Lqw.title: An Unknown Threat: Part 19
5UzAJvfO3kCzRg6wQ96Lqw.description: Bring the Renegade Defector to the Warp Gate Vribrilian.
5UzAJvfO3kCzRg6wQ96Lqw.completeDescription: Operative Smith: “We have located a small plant far outside the main system… perhaps this will do? There’s absolutely nothing there.. except for bugs… it’s located at the coordinates x: 887, y: 220”Renegade Defector: “Yes, bring me there alive… and I’ll tell you everything I know.”

x0EvptBUykSRlMbxNkuysA.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 5 (0-0)
x0EvptBUykSRlMbxNkuysA.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 5
x0EvptBUykSRlMbxNkuysA.description: Xhargreg: ”Here’s your reward; you’ll get to kill 888 ice-moths and gather their rather peculiar ice venom. Happy? What? No?? You can even keep their squishy eyes for yourself! What could be better? Now get going, I need a nap."
x0EvptBUykSRlMbxNkuysA.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Finally... that took forever... Zzzz.. are you even trying? Return to me with the poison... and please... do it before the world ends... "

I_cYteH86UOM9s7tofzvWw.label: Stalker takedown (1-3)
I_cYteH86UOM9s7tofzvWw.title: Stalker takedown
I_cYteH86UOM9s7tofzvWw.description: The Stalkers are heavy fireing units that can be a real pain. Help us clearing out 5 of them and recive a nice reward.

MsMf6IZja0-Bx9xgzhFu7Q.title: Transport assistance
MsMf6IZja0-Bx9xgzhFu7Q.description: We need some urgent supplies transferred from [location1] to [location2]. Do you have time to help us?

VDcXPx22Ak2GQ1CL95ymZQ.title: Guards, Guards!
VDcXPx22Ak2GQ1CL95ymZQ.description: We have had trouble with elite Guardians in the Kapello system, near Mari. Head out there and destroy any Guardians you see.

xRWuOSncvUS7ZqJxceKlwQ.label: Unknown Data: Part 8 (0-0)
xRWuOSncvUS7ZqJxceKlwQ.title: Unknown Data: Part 8
xRWuOSncvUS7ZqJxceKlwQ.description: A suspicious looking insectoid lurking in a corner offered to sell us the coordinates of this secret renegade base. It requested that we scout the planets: Valen, Anvol and Valden. And that we mark the locations of any valuable resources.Do you think we really can trust it? I mean... look at it!?!
xRWuOSncvUS7ZqJxceKlwQ.completeDescription: We hope the insectoid held up its end of the bargain. It gave us the following coordinates in Durian: x = 415, y = -722You should head there as soon as possible. I don’t think these guys are ready for any negotiations and we should expect a tough battle.

a1l2YRmuXkqwrqe8Sm6ycA.label: Unknown Data: Part 9 (0-0)
a1l2YRmuXkqwrqe8Sm6ycA.title: Unknown Data: Part 9
a1l2YRmuXkqwrqe8Sm6ycA.description: The Renegade research facility should be located at the coordinates: x = 415, y = -722, located in the Durian star system. We should head there as soon as possible, I don’t think these guys are ready for any negotiations, we should expect a tough battle. *hint: You can see your coordinates in the lower left corner of the map screen*

MVS7CaR5V0uZX1KpCnAp9A.label: (timed): Nexar Skirmish (90-0)
MVS7CaR5V0uZX1KpCnAp9A.title: Nexar Skirmish
MVS7CaR5V0uZX1KpCnAp9A.description: The Skirmisher seems to be the weakest Nexar ship around, but it is still deadly and has earned its place in the Nexar Fleet. It is equipped with a powerful plasma like weapon which attacks the energy suppressors in our ships. If you destroy a few of these we will give you an appropriate reward.

4QXyBdeSGUSPQGXpKAZrjw.label: Bug Legs: Part 6 (0-0)
4QXyBdeSGUSPQGXpKAZrjw.title: Bug Legs: Part 6
4QXyBdeSGUSPQGXpKAZrjw.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”It works!! HAHAhahahehheh... *coughing*… I think it likes you!”Giant Mutated Wasp: “Bzzzzz!”Crew “Eeeek!” Xhargreg: ”Excellent! But we are not done yet! Lets think bigger! ”Giant Mutated Wasp: “Bzzzzz??”

rS30CLhJzUS5DXclxns6lw.label: New Lifeform: Part 9 (0-0)
rS30CLhJzUS5DXclxns6lw.title: New Lifeform: Part 9
rS30CLhJzUS5DXclxns6lw.description: Hand over the gagged Nezerian soldier to the sponge at Barbulos in Vibrilian.
rS30CLhJzUS5DXclxns6lw.completeDescription: Krux: “bzrtzzz zz zzaz”Intelligent Sponge: “btza zz zzssarrat ttzzaaz” *Gulp*Krux: “artifacts… bz.. yours… bzzztaazz”Crew: “I think we better move out of here, the spores have infected his brain somehow..”Krux: “ztaazz!”

PjYET1cv-kKBxJrGxI3zPQ.label: (PvP-2) Make a name (2-0)
PjYET1cv-kKBxJrGxI3zPQ.title: (PvP-2) Make a name
PjYET1cv-kKBxJrGxI3zPQ.description: Nice work blowing up all those ships! It's time to get noticed and make a name for yourself. If you can manage to make enough noice you'll be welcome to join us, the Space Pirate Guild. Kill any player you can find, we don't care who you target, the weaker the better! If you can take down 25 ships you can join us and have a share of our latest plunder.

KRp0UFszvkGxTZvPot-qUg.label: (timed): Nexar Fight (90-0)
KRp0UFszvkGxTZvPot-qUg.title: Nexar Fight
KRp0UFszvkGxTZvPot-qUg.description: The fighter is an average class Nexar ship equipped with a blaster type weapon. This is probably the most standard type of enemy you can find in Vorsran and shouldn’t be a problem for an experienced pilot like you.

Tu_8-FCwcEG7_pwmdRv4UA.label: (timed): Zlatte takedown (3-0)
Tu_8-FCwcEG7_pwmdRv4UA.title: Zlatte takedown
Tu_8-FCwcEG7_pwmdRv4UA.description: The Zlattes might seem like small and easy targets. But we have encountered them in big numbers and then they are a real pain to deal with. Take down [amount] Zlatte Captain.

7PGHpfvcsEOGzywxDmqeAw.label: Eldorado: Part 2 (0-0)
7PGHpfvcsEOGzywxDmqeAw.title: Eldorado: Part 2
7PGHpfvcsEOGzywxDmqeAw.description: Goto the Warp Gate in Vibrilian.
7PGHpfvcsEOGzywxDmqeAw.completeDescription: John McClain: “Ohhh…. the warp license is pretty expensive… well. I guess I could offer you a deal, a lot of people owe me money and I need someone to collect them for me. I will give you 5% if you do it quickly. I’m eager to look for new climbing gear in Hangar 2.”

-N1F9S0qHEeA_cFV9rY5nA.label: (timed): Thorn Ambush II (17-0)
-N1F9S0qHEeA_cFV9rY5nA.title: Thorn Ambush II
-N1F9S0qHEeA_cFV9rY5nA.description: These sinister plants need to be exterminated. Kill [amount] of them and collect your reward.

6CmH3nyk80mXrcsYvId3GA.label: (timed): Hells Touchdown! (50-0)
6CmH3nyk80mXrcsYvId3GA.title: Hells Touchdown!
6CmH3nyk80mXrcsYvId3GA.description: Rumour has spread that Efedrit is a place where nobody has ever visited and come back alive. If you manage to land on Efedrit you are truly skillful, or you just teleported to your awesome friend.

zocEq3G_tkW1pxCo9nEapw.label: Questions about that past: Part 2 (0-0)
zocEq3G_tkW1pxCo9nEapw.title: Questions about that past: Part 2
zocEq3G_tkW1pxCo9nEapw.description: Dr. Mira: “If you want to help me uncover the truth about Azuron, it could be worth speaking to Wrengher Jones, he runs a recycle station here in Kapello. He was one of the first refugees to arrive here, however he refuses to talk to me. Perhaps you can be more persuasive?”
zocEq3G_tkW1pxCo9nEapw.completeDescription: Wrengher Jones: “What the hell do you want? I don’t have any time if you aren’t here for business. Just get out of here already…”

tVtQ5aYaCkq71Dle699Dog.label: (timed): Transport assistance (6-0)
tVtQ5aYaCkq71Dle699Dog.title: Transport assistance
tVtQ5aYaCkq71Dle699Dog.description: We need some urgent supplies transferred from [location1] to [location2]. Do you have time to help us?

ykQYA7JyZUuV4elIBNareg.label: (timed): Deep Waters (18-0)
ykQYA7JyZUuV4elIBNareg.title: Deep Waters
ykQYA7JyZUuV4elIBNareg.description: A scientific analysis of the biological research in Mitrilion proves the existence of Space Squids. Kill and collect [amount] samples for us.

enI1f9W9TkWWFZSwg8rx6A.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 11 (0-0)
enI1f9W9TkWWFZSwg8rx6A.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 11
enI1f9W9TkWWFZSwg8rx6A.description: Return to Xhargregs Research Station in Zergilin with the Deamon toxins.
enI1f9W9TkWWFZSwg8rx6A.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Good good, I’ve come quite far in my research, just look at this.. *dribbles some unspeakable liquid on the floor*... oh and don’t mind the corpse pile in the corner over there… they all volunteered in the name of science.Do you know of the Nezerians? I might have been working with them, a long time ago… before some.. hundreds of unfortunate and *totally* accidental deaths… Hehehehghrhrhgr... anyway since I left them I believe they have perfected their bioengineering equipment. I need you to go and *borrow* some of that equipment, you should be able to salvage enough from one Battle Ship."

6IOEzRl53kiqfNVcP0kvlw.label: Counter attack! - Part 22 (0-0)
6IOEzRl53kiqfNVcP0kvlw.title: Counter attack! - Part 22
6IOEzRl53kiqfNVcP0kvlw.description: AF Scientist: “Most interesting, the planet lacks an atmosphere and any breathable gasses… quite the harsh environment for living on. This probably means that the Nexar doesn’t use sound for communication. Perhaps this explains why they haven’t answered any of our communication attempts. Strange… I read your report about Xhargreg… seems like he was able to speak. Anyway back to the war… Admiral McArthur requested that you assist in capturing the Nexar Recycle station located in the 2nd ring.”
6IOEzRl53kiqfNVcP0kvlw.completeDescription: Admiral McArthur: “Excellent, seems like your reputation didn’t actually exceed you. This war is starting to go very well for us now. However a new threat have been reported, a force called the Nexar Elite is defending the inner circles. Your next task is to find and defeat a member of the Nexar Elite.”

s1l0zM-6lkq9l1jlGDBy4w.label: A New Beginning: Part 1 (0-0)
s1l0zM-6lkq9l1jlGDBy4w.title: A New Beginning: Part 1
s1l0zM-6lkq9l1jlGDBy4w.completeDescription: Lieutenant Kreiger: “You’re still alive? That’s quite surprising.. I thought you’d be someones dinner by now. Here’s some steel, resources are essential for long term survival. I’m going to have you prove your worth.”
s1l0zM-6lkq9l1jlGDBy4w.description: Lieutenant Kreiger: “Great, yet another refugee from Azuron. The last thing I needed… this sector have been flooded by your kind lately. I got some bad news, I doubt you’ll even last one day…  If you want to survive you need to learn how to fight, and you need to learn fast. If you want any help you’ll have to earn it. Go kill 10 of those so called “Seekers” that are swarming the area. And by the way, a small hint: they are cannibals so don’t even think of surrendering.”

zviaAScHiE2DnOsSfoH1lw.label: (timed): Recycle [amount] (3-0)
zviaAScHiE2DnOsSfoH1lw.title: Recycle [amount]
zviaAScHiE2DnOsSfoH1lw.description: The excess junk left over in a recycle is used for researching new weapons. We need you to bring in some more junk and recycle it.

GwZa9Bt7SkGMmKwOfBPF0A.label: Bug Legs: Part 22 (0-0)
GwZa9Bt7SkGMmKwOfBPF0A.title: Bug Legs: Part 22
GwZa9Bt7SkGMmKwOfBPF0A.description: Xhargreg: ”I need some fuel for the teleportation device… I’m going to have to extract it from Radiated Junk… gather 1024 pieces of it..“Truly Gigantic Mutated Wasp: “Bzz!”Crew: “Bzz to you too!Truly Gigantic Mutated Wasp: *Happy Bzz!*

gWRhBI4stkS-cIGdN5shOQ.label: (timed): Kill the Guardian! (6-0)
gWRhBI4stkS-cIGdN5shOQ.title: Kill the Guardian!
gWRhBI4stkS-cIGdN5shOQ.description: [player], we need your urgent help to take down the Guardian near Herion in Durian. Please, hurry!

nsOxXmBlqUGVL3gJysWtig.label: The Infestation: Part 5 (0-0)
nsOxXmBlqUGVL3gJysWtig.title: The Infestation: Part 5
nsOxXmBlqUGVL3gJysWtig.description: Goto Polueno in Zergilin and kill 2 Macrophages to give Ono some samples to dissect and study. She will be monitoring their energy signature and behaviour while we attack.
nsOxXmBlqUGVL3gJysWtig.completeDescription: Captain, Ono says she found something very interesting. It seem like there is a huge bioenergy reading in the middle of this system. She suspect that there is a Queen here and she insists that we have to kill it. It might reveal more about the insects and whats behind the rapid infestation.

O9qVqe3bzEK_ZhtozvPPzg.label: Counter attack! - Part 13 (0-0)
O9qVqe3bzEK_ZhtozvPPzg.title: Counter attack! - Part 13
O9qVqe3bzEK_ZhtozvPPzg.description: Contact Admiral McArthur, at the Research Station here in Vorsran.
O9qVqe3bzEK_ZhtozvPPzg.completeDescription: Admiral McArthur: “Greetings Captain, I have heard a lot about you from Admiral Ymer. It’s a pleasure to finally meet you in person. It’s time to get to work. We have to do something about those bombers, it’s going to be extremely difficult to keep our foothold here with those bombers operating freely. Our defence forces are helpless due to the enemy's stealth technology.”

LZ_kW8YLT0Kf0WLXs5S6Gg.label: The Ultimate Poison: Part 2 (0-0)
LZ_kW8YLT0Kf0WLXs5S6Gg.title: The Ultimate Poison: Part 2
LZ_kW8YLT0Kf0WLXs5S6Gg.description: Xhargreg: ”Good job, now bring all that poison to me at my research station in Zergilin."
LZ_kW8YLT0Kf0WLXs5S6Gg.completeDescription: Xhargreg: ”Why hello there! Who might you be? Oh look at all that green poison!!! Gimme! I need a few seconds to examine it..."*45 minutes later*Xhargreg: ”Why are you still here? Stop bothering me I’m busy!"*2 hours and 50 minutes later*Xhargreg: ”This poison is fantastic! I just came up with a new research topic, let’s make the perfect poison!What are you talking about? A reward? Sure, here are few bug legs, enjoy!"

tMLsAWSdvU6NqO2RTZrC-A.label: (timed): Kill [amount] Dread Moths! (20-0)
tMLsAWSdvU6NqO2RTZrC-A.title: Kill [amount] Dread Moths!
tMLsAWSdvU6NqO2RTZrC-A.description: Kill some Dread Moths for us and recieve a great reward. They can be found in the Mitrillion elite zone.
